title: 国家能源局：三批风光大基地建成超1.57亿千瓦，2030年算力用电将达8000亿千瓦时！
content:
10月30日，国家能源局举行新闻发布会，介绍前三季度全国能源形势及发展成效、可再生能源并网运行、电力市场交易、迎峰度冬电力保供举措等情况，并回答记者提问。
新能源和可再生能源司副司长桂小阳表示，2021年至2023年，我局会同国家发展改革委先后印发三批以沙漠、戈壁、荒漠地区为重点的大型风电光伏基地项目清单。这三批大基地主要是以本地消纳为主，建设工作取得积极成效。截至2026年9月底，第一批大基地9453万千瓦项目，已经基本建成投产；第二批大基地建成超3400万千瓦；第三批大基地建成超2900万千瓦。三批大基地合计建成规模超1.57亿千瓦。
同时，国家发展改革委、国家能源局编制以沙漠、戈壁、荒漠地区为重点的大型风电光伏基地规划布局方案，推动千万千瓦级大基地开发建设。这类大基地以外送消纳为主，目前我们已经批复14个基地的实施方案，其中新疆天山北麓基地（疆电入渝）、宁夏腾格里沙漠基地（宁电入湘）已相继投运。西北的风光正在送往中东部的千家万户。“沙戈荒”大基地作为全国新型电力系统的重要组成部分、“西电东送”的重要实现形式，其经济社会效益正在随着项目逐步投运逐渐显现。
从当前“沙戈荒”大基地运行情况看，规模化、集约化、以新能源为主的开发模式提高了整体开发效率，降低了开发成本，在促进产业发展、推动能源清洁低碳转型和保障电力供应的同时带动了当地就业，同时推动了沙漠、戈壁、荒漠地区生态修复，在生态治理等方面发挥了重要的综合效益。
下一步，我们一方面将加快推动以本地消纳为主的第二、三批大基地建设，力争2027年底基本建成投产。另一方面，积极推进千万千瓦级“沙戈荒”大基地建设。坚持“全国一盘棋”，结合全国电力流向，统筹谋划后续“沙戈荒”新能源基地规划布局，并按照新能源、支撑性调节性电源、输电通道“三位一体”要求，协同推进基地及配套建设，为加快构建新型电力系统、实现“双碳”目标提供有力支撑。
发展规划司副司长邢翼腾表示，能源绿色低碳转型取得新突破。7月，国内光伏发电装机容量历史性超越煤电，成为我国装机规模最大的电源品类；9月底光伏装机进一步提高到13.1亿千瓦。继上半年国内煤电发电量占比首次降至50%以下，9月底占比进一步降至49.1%，清洁能源发电新增电量占全部新增电量比重超过80%。
截至9月底，全国已建成投运新型储能装机规模达1.67亿千瓦/4.35亿千瓦时，同比增长63%。平均储能时长2.61小时，同比提升约0.27小时。全国新型储能等效利用小时数约915小时，同比增加约10小时。
前三季度，全国能源重点项目完成投资总体平稳，结构向新向优向绿趋势明显。其中，新型电网相关投资加速释放，电网、新型储能、充换电基础设施等领域投资持续增长，合计投资同比增速达到15.3%。氢能领域投资仍保持高速增长态势，投资完成额较去年同期翻一番。持续营造支持民企参与能源投资良好氛围，1—9月民企能源领域投资完成额超过1450亿元。
新能源和可再生能源司副司长桂小阳表示，前三季度，可再生能源扩量提质迈出坚实步伐，发展态势总体平稳，为完成全年目标任务奠定了良好基础。重点介绍两方面成效：
一是可再生能源装机规模稳步扩大。可再生能源新增装机占比超过七成，累计装机超过25亿千瓦、占比超六成，风光累计装机规模突破20亿千瓦、占比接近一半，光伏发电装机历史性超过煤电，成为装机规模最大的电源品种。今年前三季度，全国可再生能源新增装机1.8亿千瓦，占全部新增装机的71.7%，继续保持新增装机主体地位；其中，风光新增装机1.7亿千瓦，占全部新增装机的67.6%。截至今年9月底，全国可再生能源装机规模达到25.18亿千瓦，同比增长14.6%，约占我国总装机的60.94%；其中，风光装机合计20.1亿千瓦，约占全国电力总装机的48.66%。
二是可再生能源发电量稳健提升。可再生能源发电增量占全国发电增量的比重接近九成，已成为电力增长的主要来源。今年前三季度，全国可再生能源发电量达到3.13万亿千瓦时，同比增长约8%，占全部发电量的41.8%，超过同期第三产业用电量（16109亿千瓦时）与居民生活用电量（12346亿千瓦时）总和，可满足全社会近四成的用电需求；其中，风光发电量合计1.92万亿千瓦时，同比增长11%，占全社会用电量的23.8%，达到同期第三产业用电量（16109亿千瓦时）约1.2倍。可再生能源发电增量超过2500亿千瓦时，占全国发电增量的87.5%。
今年前三季度，全国新增水电并网容量916万千瓦，其中常规水电483万千瓦，抽水蓄能433万千瓦。截至今年9月底，全国水电累计装机容量达4.57亿千瓦，其中常规水电3.87亿千瓦，抽水蓄能0.7亿千瓦。今年前三季度，全国规模以上水电累计发电量10339亿千瓦时，全国水电累计平均利用小时数为2576小时。
风电建设和运行情况。今年前三季度，全国风电新增并网容量6066万千瓦，其中陆上风电5821万千瓦，海上风电245万千瓦。截至今年9月底，全国风电累计并网容量达到7亿千瓦，同比增长20.4%，其中陆上风电6.5亿千瓦，海上风电4984万千瓦。今年前三季度，全国风电累计发电量8554亿千瓦时，全国风电平均利用率92.1%。
光伏发电建设和运行情况。今年前三季度，全国光伏新增并网1.1亿千瓦，其中集中式光伏4580万千瓦，分布式光伏6452万千瓦。截至今年9月底，全国光伏发电装机容量达到13.1亿千瓦，同比增长16.5%，其中集中式光伏7.12亿千瓦，分布式光伏5.99亿千瓦。今年前三季度，全国光伏累计发电量10642亿千瓦时，全国光伏发电利用率93.1%。
生物质发电建设和运行情况。今年前三季度，全国生物质发电新增装机77万千瓦，累计装机达4818万千瓦，同比增长2.7%。生物质累计发电量1730亿千瓦时。 五是光热发电建设和运行情况。今年前三季度，全国光热发电新增装机50万千瓦。截至今年9月底，全国光热发电装机容量达到232万千瓦，同比增长43%。光热累计发电量14.56亿千瓦时。
电力司副司长谭洪江表示，随着人工智能产业快速发展，算力规模持续扩大。绿电直连作为算电协同的重要实现路径，通过专用供电线路就近向算力负荷供应绿电，在满足算力中心低碳用能需求的同时，促进能源消费模式变革。
总体来看，当前算电协同加力发展，绿电直连快速起步，政策体系不断健全，各地积极开展实践探索，推进算电协同项目建设。2026年“算电协同”首次写入政府工作报告，并被纳入国家“十五五”规划纲要。国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《有序推动多用户绿电直连发展有关事项的通知》（发改能源〔2026〕688号），明确了多用户绿电直连的政策导向，绿电直连顶层政策框架进一步完善，对于进一步促进新能源就近消纳、更好满足算力设施等新兴产业绿色用能需求具有重要意义。截至2026年9月底，全国已有24个省份发布绿电直连配套文件，各地已批复算力设施绿电直连项目12个，占已批复绿电直连项目的比例超10%，可以看出，算电协同与绿电直连的规模化实施，对于推动能源转型向供需双侧协同互动变革有重要意义，既是顺应算力产业用能结构调整的必然，也为新能源就地消纳开辟了新空间，打通了绿色能源供给与新兴算力产业需求之间的通道。
随着人工智能快速发展，未来算力用电需求将持续攀升，算电协同将会持续深化。预计“十五五”时期，全国算力用电量年均新增1000亿千瓦时以上，到2030年将达到8000亿千瓦时，占全社会用电量的6%左右。
下一步我们将从两方面持续发力：
一是将全面落实“以电强算、以算促电”要求，落实新型电力系统建设“十五五”规划算电协同安排，协同实施新型电网和一体化算力网建设方案。
二是以绿电直连等模式作为促进算电协同的重要方式，进一步研究相关政策举措，引导地方和企业因地制宜做好算力设施绿电直连方案论证和项目落地，遴选典型项目互学互鉴，形成可复制可推广的经验，更好促进算电协同高质量发展。
我们相信，算电协同与绿电直连政策项目的落地见效，将有力支撑人工智能产业绿色发展，为新型电力系统建设注入新动能。

title: 年处理15万吨！这一电池回收基地一期在重庆投产
content:
图/重庆双桥经济技术开发区管理委员会
据重庆双桥经济技术开发区管理委员会消息，10月30日，位于双桥经开区邮亭工业园区的重庆环锂循环科技有限公司（简称：重庆环锂）年拆解10万辆报废汽车、年处理15万吨退役锂电池及锂镍钴中间品综合利用项目（一期）正式投产，成为当前西南地区规模最大的新能源汽车拆解及锂电循环综合利用基地。
据悉，该项目总占地450亩，定位为全产业链锂电综合回收基地，致力于打造数字化、绿色化、智能化、零碳化的行业标杆工厂。全面达产后，项目将构建起覆盖报废汽车回收拆解、退役锂电池精细化分选回收、锂镍钴关键材料再生的完整业务链条，全面提升退役动力电池与报废汽车的高值化资源化利用水平，预计年产值可达30亿元至50亿元。
资料显示，重庆环锂项目是江西环锂新能源科技有限公司（简称：江西环锂）深耕西南循环经济市场的核心战略项目。
江西环锂成立于2011年8月，注册资金约9649万元，地处江西省宜春市袁州区主要从事锂资源提锂回收提纯加工、锂动力电池回收梯度利用、氯化锂、电池级碳酸锂、钴化合物、镍化合物、镍钴锰三元材料、磷酸铁锂、生态环保材料、新能源材料产品的研发、制造、销售。

title: 50亿元！一圆柱电池领域项目落地江苏常州
content:
图/常州发布
据“常州发布”消息，10月30日，常州国家高新技术产业开发区管委会与江苏睿恩新能源科技股份有限公司签署投资协议，睿恩新能源极片智造基地二期项目落地常州高新区。
据悉，睿恩新能源极片智造基地二期项目总投资50亿元，预计2027年初开工。项目计划建设极片产线10条，建成后将形成50GWh极片生产能力，新引进相关博士、硕士约50人，新增生产及研发人员约400人，新增专利超400项，达产后新增年销售约35亿元。
资料显示，睿恩新能源成立于2021年，总部位于江苏常州，长期聚焦无极耳圆柱锂电芯赛道，核心研发团队拥有十余年锂电池技术积淀，自主突破全极耳核心工艺，推出RS50、RS60等高倍率21700电芯产品。公司产品具备高比能、超快充、宽温域、长寿命等优势，广泛应用于高端园林电动工具、电动超跑、低空经济、人形机器人、算力中心备用电源等领域。
除国内基地外，电池网注意到，8月31日，塞尔维亚政府、因吉亚市政府与睿恩新能源正式签署框架协议，将在塞尔维亚因吉亚（Inđija）建设高性能电芯制造工厂。项目一期计划投资超1亿欧元（约合人民币7.8亿元）。

title: Rivian's Charging Network Grew 39% In A Year
content:
Rivian's Charging Network Grew 39% In A Year
The startup is actively investing in its own EV fast charging network, even though its models can use Tesla Superchargers.
- Rivian hasn’t forgotten about its DC fast charging network.
- The Rivian Adventure Network grew 39% in the last 12 months, surpassing 1,000 individual chargers.
- Meanwhile, the company’s slower Waypoint chargers aren’t getting much love.
Rivian’s Adventure Network of DC fast chargers has expanded nearly 40% in the last 12 months, surpassing 1,100 individual chargers and 150 locations across the United States.
The company said in its third-quarter earnings report that its EV fast charging network now has 1,185 ports capable of delivering up to 300 kilowatts of power, up 39% compared to last year’s third quarter. Meanwhile, the number of stations has gone up to 165, or 26% more than at the end of Q3 2025.
Rivian DC fast charger
The startup claims its fast chargers are powered by 100% renewable energy, though that doesn’t always mean that he electricity coming out of a charger is sourced from a photovoltaic array or a wind farm. Instead, every kilowatt-hour delivered through a RAN charger is matched with renewable sources that may operate in another town or another state.
Rivian has continued to invest in its own charging infrastructure, which uses purpose-built stalls, even though its passenger models have access to tens of thousands of public DC chargers across the U.S., including countless NACS-equipped Tesla Superchargers.
However, while the DC charging infrastructure was mentioned in the startup’s latest presentation, the Waypoints network of Level 2 chargers has gotten a lot less attention. The slower chargers didn’t get a single mention in any of the company’s most recent documents, but they haven’t been completely forgotten.
That said, the growth rate seems to have been significantly slower compared to the RAN network. According to data from the Department of Energy’s Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC), the company installed just ten 11-kilowatt chargers this year, with the latest pair going online in October. In total, Rivian operates 540 Waypoint Level 2 chargers at 208 locations in the U.S.
Despite the quick growth in its DC charging network, the California startup is still a tiny player in a rapidly evolving industry. By comparison, Tesla, the biggest name in the game, has over 40,000 fast charging ports at nearly 3,300 locations in the U.S., with an additional 14,000 Level 2 Destination Chargers at almost 4,000 sites.

title: AI-Powered Coffee Runs And Service Visits Are Coming To Rivians In 2027
content:
AI-Powered Coffee Runs And Service Visits Are Coming To Rivians In 2027
Rivian Chief Software Officer Wassym Bensaid says new AI integrations will order your coffee and automate vehicle service starting next year.
Rivian's AI assistant will soon order coffee on your route so it’s fresh when you arrive at a coffee shop.
Future updates will automatically diagnose vehicle issues and book service appointments behind the scenes.
Rivian aims to eventually let owners control virtually every vehicle function through voice and AI.
When Rivian launched its in-house AI assistant in May, the company promised that the tech would soon do far more than answer ChatGPT-style questions, switch on the A/C, or text your friends. It pitched a chatbot that could be deeply integrated into your R1S or R2—but also deeply integrated into your life.
The Assistant hit the scene with Google Calendar capability, allowing drivers to move meetings on the fly, and Gmail came in October. In an interview on the Plugged-In Podcast this week, Rivian Chief Software Officer Wassym Bensaid said flashier integrations are coming soon, including one that will overhaul the service experience for Rivian owners.
"What I'm really excited about is the possibility in the future where you can bring your own personal digital ecosystem to the car through these AI integrations, and then also the possibility that you can start integrating with multiple other agentic experiences," he said.
One example: ordering coffee on your way to work. Bensaid said the Assistant will be able to help you order coffee from the right place at the right time, so that it's at the right temperature when you swing by.
The Rivian Assistant can answer general knowledge questions, control the vehicle, and integrate with a driver's Google Calendar and Gmail.
Thanks to AI, the experience of getting a Rivian serviced will become a lot smoother and more automated, he said. Rivian's AI tech will soon proactively diagnose issues, set up service appointments for owners, and make sure the service center has the right parts before an owner arrives, he said.
"That's a complete paradigm shift in that entire experience, and not only enables us to have a much more delightful experience for customers, but then it's a big efficiency lever for us and it helps us be much more competitive from a cost standpoint for something like service," he said.
We asked when exactly Rivian owners can expect these features to hit their vehicles. Bensaid said a lot of them are already in the works but need to get more reliable before a wider release.
"We're very close," he said. "We're talking about things that we will launch in 2027."
To check out our full Wassym Bensaid interview, head to Spotify, Apple, or scroll down to the video player below.
Rivian has an ambitious tech vision for its AI. And the Rivian Assistant is already impressive in some ways. But owners have also complained about shortcomings. I asked Bensaid about those growing pains.
"Similar to other features, other technologies, there's still tuning, and there's still some refinements that we need to continue doing," he said. "A lot of them is on us, which is great. Some of them are work with our partners in terms of how we ground some of the requests and how we really optimize them."
But getting today's features right is only part of the challenge. Rivian ultimately wants the Assistant to handle virtually anything drivers can do through the touchscreen.
"Our philosophy is eventually, through that deep OS integration, the end state is really having that ability to, through voice and through AI, you will be able to do everything that you're doing with your fingers on the screen."

title: Waymo's Public Fast-Charging Problem Is Infuriating EV Drivers
content:
Waymo's Public Fast-Charging Problem Is Infuriating EV Drivers
Robotaxi companies need to figure out how their driverless cars can be less annoying for everyday drivers.
- Some Waymo robotaxis in San Diego, California, are crowding public fast charging stations.
- Regular electric vehicle drivers are frustrated as they have to wait for spots to open up.
- Waymo said it prioritizes charging at its own depots.
Imagine pulling up to a public fast-charging station for a quick top-up, only to find several Waymo robotaxis occupying the stalls. That's reportedly happening in San Diego, California, where some EV drivers say they've had to wait up to an hour or find another charging location.
The Alphabet-owned company is rapidly expanding across the U.S. and now serves riders in 15 cities. But its growing fleet is creating an unexpected headache for some EV drivers. While Waymo operates dedicated depots for vehicle maintenance and charging, some of its robotaxis are also using public fast-charging stations, the Los Angeles Times reported Friday.
“They come in droves,” one driver told the outlet.
Waymo told the newspaper that it has people at some public charging locations to assist robotaxis as they arrive, and that it tries to avoid having vehicles crowd one station. Its Jaguar I-Paces and Zeekr vans that are sometimes driven by humans may also use public chargers during breaks, the spokesperson said. The company prioritizes its own charging hubs, Waymo said. But setting up dedicated facilities can take time when entering new markets.
The friction between Waymos and EV drivers highlights how the arrival of autonomous vehicles is creating some unexpected headaches.
EV drivers in Nashville and St. Louis have also accused Waymos of hogging public chargers, according to social media posts. Santa Monica residents also complained last year about noise from Waymos returning from overnight shifts which had beeping parking sensors and flashing lights. In San Francisco, residents have reported Waymos honking at each other in the middle of the night at a depot.
EVgo told the LA Times that its San Diego chargers are available to both private EV drivers and robotaxis. In other words, Waymo isn't breaking any rules by plugging in. But that doesn't make the situation any less frustrating for drivers who depend on those stations.
It’s certainly an awkward situation. Building more public fast chargers will help—and we know that’s happening nationwide at a steady speed. And Waymo says it prioritizes its own private depots. But as it stands, robotaxis and human drivers are competing for limited real estate.

title: 能源装备与新能源技术跨界融合 上海电气与宁德时代战略合作
content:
双方将依托各自行业领军优势，在零碳园区、新型储能、绿色交通、算电协同、供应链协同、科技创新及国际业务七大领域开展深化合作，打造能源装备与新能源技术跨界融合的产业标杆。

图片来源：上海电气
据上海电气（601727）消息，10月30日，上海电气与宁德时代（300750）签署战略合作协议。
据介绍，根据协议，双方将依托各自行业领军优势，在零碳园区、新型储能、绿色交通、算电协同、供应链协同、科技创新及国际业务七大领域开展深化合作，打造能源装备与新能源技术跨界融合的产业标杆，助力新型电力系统建设与“双碳”战略落地。
上海电气集团党委书记、董事长吴磊表示，上海电气正加快向绿色智能系统解决方案服务商转型，持续巩固煤电、核电、气电等传统能源装备优势，加快培育风光储氢、绿色化工装备等低碳产业，并布局船舶配套、航空航天零部件、输配电等多元工业装备业务。期待以本次战略合作协议签署为新起点，与宁德时代构建长期稳定、双向赋能的战略伙伴关系，在供应链联合研发、绿色低碳产业共建、海外市场协同开拓等领域深化务实合作，持续释放协同价值。
宁德时代董事长、总经理曾毓群表示，宁德时代长期深耕动力电池、储能及智能制造领域，持续输出零碳解决方案。期待双方深化供应链协同联动，围绕锂电下一代工艺装备开展联合研发试制，加快推进工业机器人、具身机器人在电池产线场景落地；携手共建绿色低碳产业生态，探索以联合体、联合投资等方式参与零碳园区、零碳工厂建设，合力攻关新型储能系统技术；协同拓展全球市场，发挥宁德时代全球化产业布局优势与上海电气技术与工程集成能力，共同挖掘海外优质项目机遇。

title: 打通全流程工艺链路 利元亨全固态电池整线设备出机国内头部客户
content:
利元亨深耕固态电池装备研发，打通全流程工艺链路，实现整线装备完全自主可控，可兼容半固态批量生产与全固态中试、准量产需求，适配硫化物、氧化物、卤化物多类电解质体系。

图片来源：利元亨
据利元亨（688499）消息，近日，公司为国内某头部企业打造的全固态电池整线设备顺利完成出机，为下一代动力电池从实验室研发走向规模化制造筑牢坚实的装备底座。
固态电池量产制造面临多重技术挑战
固态电池凭借高能量密度、本质安全、长循环寿命的突出优势，成为全球新能源产业竞相布局的战略赛道。但固‑固界面阻抗高、孔隙难以控制、极易发生边缘短路等制造难题，长期制约商业化落地。区别于传统液态锂电池，全固态电池对前段制备、中段成型、后段激活全链条装备提出颠覆性要求。利元亨深耕固态电池装备研发，打通全流程工艺链路，实现整线装备完全自主可控，可兼容半固态批量生产与全固态中试、准量产需求，适配硫化物、氧化物、卤化物多类电解质体系。
全链条设备破解固态电池制造瓶颈
围绕五大核心工艺痛点，利元亨完成系列硬核装备技术攻关。干法电极涂布机革新传统湿法路线，减少11.5%溶剂消耗，能耗降低46%，构建自支撑干电极膜；辊压热复合双轧一体机集成极片压实与电解质转印复合，优化固固界面均匀性；胶框成型叠片一体机实现微米级精度管控，从源头规避极片边缘短路风险；温等静压机依托帕斯卡原理实现电芯各向同性致密加压，大幅降低界面孔隙与接触阻抗；高压化成分容设备承载高达150吨拘束压力，搭载百余项安全防护功能，完成电芯界面激活与一致性筛选。针对硫化物体系，设备集成硫化氢监测、密闭微负压防护体系，守住安全生产底线。
为加速工艺协同验证，利元亨搭建固态电池洁净实验室，面向行业开放联合研发测试，打通装备与材料工艺联动闭环。本次整线交付，是产学研协同创新的重要里程碑，印证国产高端装备已具备支撑全固态电池中试放大的硬核实力。
利元亨表示，面向电动化广阔未来，公司将持续深化装备工艺一体化能力，助力客户加快工艺迭代与产能验证，推动固态电池技术落地于新能源汽车、大规模储能、eVTOL、人形机器人等多元场景，为新能源产业链高质量发展注入强劲动能。

title: 本月玩什么｜影之刃零、战争机器：事变日等 - 少数派
content:
，本栏目将从作者个人角度出发，独立挑选一些本月新发售的游戏作品/内容做简要介绍、评论，不保证收录覆盖面，且并非每一款都是笔者推荐游玩的，主要涵盖 PlayStation、Xbox、Nintendo、PC 和 iOS/Android 等主流平台；请注意，本文的探讨仅限于游戏刚发售时点的表现，游戏未来可能通过迭代变得更好或更差。期待这里能有勾起你兴趣的内容或探讨，也真诚感谢所有喜欢本栏目的朋友。
本栏目设有有奖互动环节
，上一期中奖的幸运读者是
@endertw
希望复活的 IP：第一部是《失落星球》，也是号称「显卡危机第二」了，当年在网吧电脑上玩过一段时间的（家里电脑带不动），感觉很震撼，科幻感十足，只可惜再没有玩到类似感觉的游戏了，整个系列也没有出过新作了，Capcom 可能也放弃了；第二部就是最近新出的《恶魔城》了，只可惜看评价新版恶魔城没有那味了，只剩下了跳跳乐，那我就有点不想要了
希望推出的新作：接上文，既然《恶魔城》不行了，那我只能又掏出2024年才玩过的《密特罗德生存恐惧》又爽通了一遍，然后也知道密特罗德新作明年 1 月又要出了，要不要这么爽，自从 GBA 开始玩密特罗德，基本上后面出的都要爽玩，老任还是牛逼，萨姐也继续牛逼就对了！
影之刃零 / Phantom Blade Zero
源自原创 IP《雨血》的武侠单机之梦。
2026.10.29 / PS5、PC
由北京灵游坊（S-GAME）开发并自行发行，团队创始人梁其伟担任了本作制作人、总监，他向这个 IP 倾注了快 20 年的心血：2008 年左右，学生时代的梁其伟就用 RPG Maker 独立制作了《雨血：死镇》，后来拉起了队伍推出《雨血 2：烨城》《雨血前传：蜃楼》等；《蜃楼》虽取得约 30 万套的销量成绩，但还不足以支撑公司，最终网易入股结束了灵游坊的关门危机，双方开始合作经营脱胎于《雨血》的手游《影之刃》；一晃就是十年，直到今天《影之刃零》面世，灵游坊在这个 IP 上孵化出了 3A 级单机作品。
《影之刃零》采用虚幻引擎 5 开发，可以看作是原版《雨血》的重新演绎，不要求玩家接触过灵游坊的其他作品。本作最早在 2023 年索尼 PlayStation Showcase 上正式亮相，但灵游坊已内部酝酿了很久，2016 年提出了构想、2022 年启动全面开发，据称灵游坊还在开发过程中砍了很多项目，足见有股破釜沉舟的架势。
故事发生在名为「影境」的虚构舞台，设定了强风格化的视听、宏大的势力角力、复杂的武侠术语，玩家将扮演顶尖刺客「魂」，正面临所属组织的追杀，流程就随着通缉令的倒计时来推进。虽然主角叫「魂」，但梁其伟强调，他并不把本作视为类魂游戏，立体式的关卡设计算有致敬，但团队更多是在想，在动作游戏赛道上怎样不走老路、超越《忍者龙剑传》（忍者龍剣伝）或《鬼泣》（Devil May Cry）。
本作最深下功夫的无疑是动作方面，得到了着重的宣传。今年 8 月的预购启动宣传中，开发团队重磅介绍了甄子丹从 2023 年起担任了本作创意顾问、亲自出演了名为「魔渊」的游戏内角色，其麾下「甄家班」亦参与战斗设计。
PC Gamer
打趣道，懂行的朋友或许早有预期，因为《影之刃零》刚开始宣传时就提到了谷垣健治担任动作指导，后者正是甄子丹三十年的老搭档。
就笔者的观察而言，星光熠熠的武指团队还真不太噱头，因为梁其伟在与
等的多篇访谈中提到，团队极其重视独特、丰富的动作，而且是实实在在基于捕捉得来的动作，团队的原则是，有海量且多变的动画才有流畅的战斗、类人单位尽量上动捕、一把武器对应一整套角色动作（不止主角），等等。根据宣传，游戏收录了三十多种主武器、二十多种副武器（小技能），没有偏传统 RPG 式的角色升级加点，成长就依赖武器变化和技能树分支，至少光看纸面，相比起重在加数值的「量变」成长，《影之刃零》的「质变」成长更令笔者倾心。
目前游戏刚刚发售，笔者尚未上手，翻看了一下社区，看到不少「低于预期」的评价。游玩者的简评中，我记忆最深刻的是「画风的割裂」：似乎游戏流程中插入了 2D 剧情动画，还有一些角色、物件的形象不够仿古。这让我想起了当年玩《河洛英雄传》的玩后感，俯视角的城市漫游、战棋战斗还没享受够，出了城、猛地切到 2D 仙侠风看板玩法，瞬间给我浇了盆冷水，所以我还挺能共情武侠作品「割裂」带来的失望。
战争机器：事变日 / Gears of War: E-Day
虚幻引擎 5 驱动的《战争机器》前传新作。
2026.10.06 / XS X|S、PC
Xbox Game Studios 发行，第一方工作室 The Coalition 与波兰的 People Can Fly 联合开发，第三人称射击玩法，以系列迄今为止最高的技术力，畅想了《战争机器》（Gears of War）时间线早期的故事。
让我们回到初代的十四年前，地底的邪物「蝗虫」（Locust）刚刚破土而出，那改变了一切的一天被称为「事变日」（Emergence Day，简称 E-Day）。本作中，我们再次看到年轻的人气主角 Marcus Fenix、Dom Santiago，还有新角色 Mags Carter、Lucas Reyes，四人组成 Bravo 小队，亲历前线城市的沦陷。
创意总监 Matt Searcy 曾告诉
，团队想讲一个恐怖的故事，让人们不再觉得蝗虫是送给玩家们割的草，「恢复」它们「地下涌出的可怕怪物」的真实身份，他告诉
Pure Xbox
，团队想做出「the best f***ing Gears game」。笔者并非《战争机器》系列玩家，但本作的实机、宣传片确实展现了这种深沉且不安的感觉，很多媒体的试玩反馈也提供了佐证。
Game Informer
在提前体验感想中提到，本作一开头就有恐怖游戏的感觉，认为这是 The Coalition 从 Epic Games 接手该系列以来的最佳作品，
的编辑则觉得从《事变日》中看到了《生化危机 2》（Resident Evil 2）的影子。笔者注意到消极反馈主要针对叙事，
在文章中评价《事变日》很热闹、但缺乏情感，当人们再一次看到 Marcus 与 Dom 同框，粉丝难免会期待他们兄弟之间的化学反应，但这种期待在整个流程中只被兑现了「45 秒」——天知道发生了什么。
《战争机器》前三代都是 Epic Games 开发，2006 年起在 Xbox 360 上独占发行，核心设计师是 Cliff Bleszinski，打磨了一套「靠掩体、探出头射击、清除敌人后前进」的战斗玩法循环，还有冲到敌人面前、用枪下挂载的链锯处决这样的招牌机制，带起了一阵风潮，比如你在《Spec Ops: The Line》这种背景、敌我设定、武器配置都完全不同的作品里，也能体验到受《战争机器》启发的「近身枪斗」。2005 年 Rod Fergusson 从微软跳槽到 Epic 担任执行制作人，和 Bleszinski 一起护航该系列，直到三部曲结束后，两人先后离开 Epic。2014 年微软买下了《战争机器》IP，Fergusson 回归领导负责后续作品的 The Coalition 工作室，到 2020 年他又去了暴雪，所以该系列最灵魂的早期核心主创都未参与《事变日》。
空战奇兵 8 希孚之翼 / Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
很难想象上代发售以后都过了 7 年了。
2026.10.02 / PS5、XS X|S、PC
来自万代南梦宫的《空战奇兵》正统续作、同时也是系列 30 周年纪念作品，国内民间通常译为「皇牌空战」，这里我采用了官方的译名。本作的制作人河野一聪从 2 代起就一直参与系列相关工作，担任了 4 代美术总监、5 代游戏总监、7 代的制作人，延续《空战奇兵》主线的剧情继续由《在这世界的角落》（この世界の片隅に）导演片渊须直操刀。
GAME Watch
的采访，本作立项于前作大卖之后，对它的要求是「深化」而非「进化」，所以看起来 7、8 两代的卖相比较接近，8 代的故事从前作 10 年后开始讲起，在世界战争格局演变的背景下，主角被安排顶替已故王牌机师「希孚之翼」领军作战，带领杂牌中队冲锋陷阵，听起来有种刻板印象的中二感。
本作给自己定了一个叫「Dramatic Flight Shooting」的类型名，河野在采访中说，这是因为不少玩家反馈，没想到这种开飞机战斗的游戏里还有剧情，他在与
的访谈中也认真补充道，《希孚之翼》是系列首次在过场剧情中大面积应用第一人称，从一开始，剧情与战斗的部分就是同步在打磨，最后阶段微调无线电通讯（我特别喜欢这个场景下对话语音的质感）、音乐等细节，最终抵达打动人心的效果。
老实说，笔者也属于是没有认真关心过系列剧情的那类人，《空战奇兵》系列最早的游玩经历是 PSP 的版本，后来热情游玩了口碑堪比系列之耻的《空战奇兵：突击地平线》（Ace Combat: Assault Horizon）——我还真挺喜欢 DFM 机炮演出的，在 7 代发售时重燃了激情、购入至今仍未游玩，我想现在如果两部连续游玩，应该也是美事一桩。
星球大战：银河赛车手 / Star Wars: Galactic Racer
幼年天行者竞速体验券。
2026.10.06 / PS5、XS X|S、PC
英国工作室 Fuse Games 开发、Secret Mode 发行，《星球大战》IP 的竞速题材作品。如果你熟悉《星球大战》前传三部曲，那么这部作品所处的背景就非常容易理解了，这就是 Anakin Skywalker 小时候参加的那种悬浮车竞速赛，这一次你将在座舱里亲自体验风驰电掣。说实话，操作飞车的狂飙速度感让我又一次对 Anakin 预言之子的身份肃然起敬。
本作设定在《星球大战 VI：绝地归来》（Star Wars Episode VI – Return of the Jedi）之后的新共和国时期，玩家们将驾驶自己喜欢的、《星球大战》原味载具，参加盛大的「银河联赛」，单人模式采用 Roguelike 的玩法框架，会有随机生成的赛程，比赛过程也绝不是普通竞速游戏那么单纯，去放心大胆地挤爆你的对手吧。
本作的开发团队值得提一嘴，Fuse Games 其实是资深竞速团队 Criterion Games 的一批核心成员 2023 年创立的，创始人 Matt Webster 在 EA 旗下工作了 32 年，参与过初代《FIFA》，在 Criterion 参与制作过《Burnout》，还参与过《星球大战：前线》（Star Wars Battlefront）的两代游戏。Webster 告诉
GamesRadar+
，《星球大战》初代的飞车赛给了他和团队巨大的影响，帮助他们完成了《Burnout》，如今有机会真正把那种《星球大战》电影里的体验演绎成游戏，就好像人生兜兜转转又回了原点。
银松镇 / Silver Pines
一名私家侦探，来到一座《双峰》式的小镇，寻找失踪的音乐人。
2026.10.08 / PS5、XS X|S、NS、NS2、PC
Team17 发行，Wych Elm Games 的出道作，该团队总共只有五人，分散在瑞典、挪威远程办公，他们曾参与过《绝地潜兵 2》（Helldivers 2）、《黑暗领域》（The Darkness）、《尤库的小岛速递》（Yoku's Island Express）等作品，据联合创始人 Linus Larsson 介绍，2021 年大家一起构思项目时，决定做一部比他们以往的出品更黑暗的游戏。
于是乎，在《银松镇》中，玩家将扮演私家侦探 Red Walker，被一通电话带到神秘且荒芜的小镇，受托寻找失踪的音乐人 Eddie Velvet。游戏采用了横版动作玩法，强调银河城式的往复探索，整个过程伴随着稀缺的背包格子与资源，还要找各种东西来战斗或解锁区域（普遍一物多用），想休息了就到电话亭投币存档。
我知道你可能想到了点什么，Larsson 也是这么跟
说的，本作从前三部《生化危机》以及《寂静岭》（Silent Hill）等游戏获取了灵感，还广泛吸收了《八毫米》（8MM）、《X 档案》（The X-Files）、《双峰》（Twin Peaks）等古早惊悚影视作品的影响。访谈还提到了本作美术方面的匠心，开发者用了转描（Rotoscoping）技术处理角色动画，单主角就有超过 1800 张手绘帧，在做怪物的动作时，先拍正常的动作做参考、再转描倒放的帧，不得不说，这一点确实在《银松镇》的宣传片中增色不少。
最终幻想 共鸣 / FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
如果《最终幻想》在《FFVI》之后一直用像素画下去。
2026.10.22 / PS5、XS X|S、NS、NS2、PC
Square Enix 出品，第一部采用 HD-2D 风格的《最终幻想》（What took you so long?），基于最早 2015 年上线的移动平台游戏《最终幻想：勇气启示录》（FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS）回炉重造而来，移动平台原版的国服、国际服、日服先后于 2022 年、2024 年、2025 年停运。
本作的制作人中岛启辅此前在《勇气启示录》任助理制作人，他在接受
Game*Spark
采访时说，《共鸣》这个项目构思了五六年，觉得《勇气启示录》的《FF》味很浓、只停在社交游戏的程度太可惜了，本作也是骄傲地打出了口号：如果《FFVI》后面的作品也沿用像素画，《FF》到今天会不会就是这样？
原版游戏是典型的抽卡型作品：玩家购买代币、抽历代《FF》角色的「幻影」、养成队伍、花体力值挑战关卡。本作改编了原版第一季的剧情，但不值得期待，
Push Square
的编辑觉得剧情「非常、非常好猜」，且角色「极其脸谱化」。抽卡和体力值机制已移除（虽然痕迹还在），启用了系列经典的回合制战斗，还有早期《FF》经典的大地图、飞空艇、暗雷、召唤兽等元素回归。
以上便是部分近期值得探讨的新游信息汇总，个人角度仅供参考。本期不设特定有奖互动话题，欢迎你在评论区分享 10 月新作的游玩体验，可以是本文出现的，也可以是本文未提及、但你特别想推荐给派友的。

title: 刚刚，DeepSeek重磅开源：Agent底座架构！
content:
刚刚，DeepSeek重磅开源：Agent底座架构！
AI已经自己找到Bug并提交PR
梦瑶 发自 凹非寺
量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI
DeepSeek，又有新动作了！
而且这回，官方直接把Personal Agent的底层架构思路公开了。
要知道，此前不少人还在等DeepSeek推出传闻中的「dsh dot」，结果这次先等来了一篇面向工程实践的架构思路探讨——
Super-agent：迈向更自主的Agent系统。
何意味？AI可以在没人@、没人下指令的情况下，自己发现Bug、定位问题，甚至主动提交修复PR了。
甚至它还能持续关注工作群消息，跨平台协作、并行处理多个复杂任务，甚至实现24小时在线运行。
DeepSeek团队还晒出了初步实测成绩——
在模拟多任务环境中，Super-agent的任务完成时间中位数为12.4分钟，95分位数为15.7分钟，表现优于测试中的传统单会话方案。
AI，真的开始有能力从等待人类逐项分配任务，进一步走向主动发现问题、持续推进工作了。
群里没人@，AI已经自己找到Bug并提交PR
在日常软件开发过程中，开发人员经常碰到的一个问题是，我们需要在不同平台之间来回切换！！
比如，先在IM群聊里讨论技术方案，随后到GitHub提交代码，再根据PR评论修改实现。
对于传统Coding Agent来说，这些操作往往分散在不同会话里——
用户得自己记住每个会话进行到了哪里，再把相关上下文交代给AI。
DeepSeek团队在文章中提到，根据他们的观察，一个人通常只能同时跟进3到5个活跃Session。
这就带来了一个问题：随着模型处理单项任务的能力越来越强，多任务协作的效率，却越来越容易受到人类注意力的限制。
好巧不巧的是，Super-agent要解决的，正是这一问题。
在DeepSeek团队内部运行的实例中，同一个开发任务可以从IM群聊一直延续到GitHub PR评审。
比如，用户先在群里决定采用方案A，随后又在GitHub评论里要求改成方案B。
Super-agent能够理解这两条消息属于同一项工作，并据此调整后续执行方向。
用户面对的始终是同一个Agent，底层的多个会话则由系统自行管理，而且它开始主动参与工作。
这里还用到了一项技术——投机执行（Speculative Execution）。
就是AI发现某件事可能需要处理时，可以提前在后台尝试。
比如群里有人讨论一个Bug，Super-agent便先着手复现、查找原因，如果最终找到简单可行的修复方案，就把结果交给用户。
如果没有找到有效结果，则可以保持安静，避免打扰，同样的思路也能用于个人助手。
收到会议邀约后，AI可以提前检查日程冲突、整理相关资料，并准备好回复草稿，等待用户确认。
这也对应着DeepSeek为Super-agent提出的四个核心特征：
- 连续： 跨会话、跨工作平台保持任务上下文，不用反复解释前情。
- 高效： 多个复杂任务并行执行，耗时任务不会阻塞新的交互。
- 主动： 持续观察环境变化，在有必要时自行采取行动。
- 持久： 长期在线运行，遇到异常能够尝试自动恢复。
DeepSeek为此设计了一套双层架构。
上层叫Router，可以理解为负责接收消息和统筹任务的调度员，下层叫Worker，则是一组负责具体执行任务的Agent会话。
具体来说，上层的Router相当于总调度员，负责接收消息、分配任务和维护全局上下文。
下层的Worker则负责具体执行，多个任务可以同时推进，互不干扰。
值得注意的是，DeepSeek还专门设计了订阅与直通机制——
举个例子，某个Worker接手一条GitHub PR后，就能直接订阅后续评论。
之后有人提出修改意见，消息会直接交给这个Worker处理，无需再经过Router层层转发。
这样一来，老任务有人持续跟进，新任务也能及时分配，整个系统就能更高效地运转起来。
24小时在线、自主恢复，实测任务完成时间更稳定
除了多任务协作，要让Super-agent长期自主运行，还得解决消息过滤、任务阻塞和异常恢复等问题。
当Agent同时接入工作群、GitHub、邮件等平台，大量消息会持续涌入，但真正需要处理的可能只有少数。
为此，DeepSeek设计了两级事件过滤机制——
先通过程序规则筛除无关消息，再由大模型判断剩余事件是否需要采取行动，减少不必要的Token消耗。
与此同时，Super-agent还引入了异步ReAct Loop。
AI执行耗时任务时，仍能继续响应新指令，无需等上一项任务完成。该机制已在DeepSeek Harness中实现，但尚未默认开启。
至于24小时在线，DeepSeek采用了计算、状态与执行环境分离的思路。
Agent的计算逻辑可以在云端运行，会话状态独立保存，本地设备则保留原有工作环境，即便电脑暂时离线，云端Agent也能维持任务状态，等设备重新上线后继续执行相关工作。
更进一步，团队还引入了独立的Watchdog（看门狗）机制。
它相当于一个专门负责监督其他Agent的AI，既能检测程序故障，也能判断任务是否陷入无效循环、偏离目标，并尝试介入修复。
DeepSeek团队还进行了一组初步实验——
他们模拟了包含约300条消息、20项工作请求的协作环境，对比Super-agent与传统单Session加Subagent方案，每种配置重复测试5次。
结果显示，Super-agent任务完成时间中位数：12.4分钟，95分位任务完成时间：15.7分钟。
传统单Session方案在中性提示下，95分位任务完成时间达到29.5分钟。
当然，效率提升也伴随着一定的Token开销。
DeepSeek发现，取消事件直通机制后，Router的决策次数增加约30%，读取缓存Token增加约37%。
这也说明，合理的事件路由能够有效降低系统运行成本。
从这次技术分享来看，DeepSeek正在探索让Agent进一步摆脱单次会话限制，实现持续在线、并行执行、主动响应和异常自愈。
当AI逐渐能够独立完成复杂任务，如何让它长期、稳定地推进多项工作，也开始成为Agent系统需要解决的新问题。
GItHub链接：

title: 你的8G iPad里有12G内存！库克走了但他的刀法追着我砍
content:
你的8G iPad里有12G内存！库克走了但他的刀法追着我砍
苹果“牛奶倒河里”式操作翻红
一水 发自 凹非寺量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI
不是哥们，苹果这“精准刀法”，是不是有点太狠、太绝、太资本主义了？？
这几年AI大潮来了，苹果押注未来的准头，只能说不敢恭维。
但一说到怎么砍配置、分档位、拿捏用户预算，苹果突然又准得像接入了“世界模型”。
这回，甚至连已经焊进机器里的内存，都没能逃过这一刀。
最近，苹果就因为这么一桩事，又被网友狠狠吐槽了一通。
尤其是两年前买了M4 iPad Pro的老用户，看完更是血压飙升。
甚至有网友直言：
苹果这刀法，已经到了“不人道”的程度。
苹果“牛奶倒河里”式操作翻红
这事儿还得从X上一条浏览量破两百万的帖子说起。
就在最近，博主@mylifcc突然开喷，称苹果的“精准刀法”已经进化到了“不人道（inhumane）”的程度。
矛头直指2024年发布的M4 iPad Pro。
明明装了标称容量合计12GB的内存颗粒，苹果却只给用户8GB可用内存。
内存的钱都花了，颗粒也焊进主板了，苹果却愣是让其中4GB容量闲着。
博主给出的解释相当扎心：
还不是为了守住高配版的溢价空间！
毕竟低配8GB，高配16GB，想要更多内存就得多花钱升级。
要是低配直接给到12GB，谁还愿意为了那4GB差距多掏钱？
苹果宁愿自己多花钱买硬件，也不肯让低配用户占到一点便宜。
这操作，谁看了不说一句“这不就是科技版的牛奶倒河里？”
而这场争议的源头，还要追溯到两年前。
2024年5月，苹果推出了M4 iPad Pro，256GB和512GB版本统一内存只有8GB，想要16GB，就得直接升级到1TB或2TB版本。
典型的苹果精准刀法。
结果新机刚上市没多久，MacRumors论坛上一位名叫layerstack的网友，就从拆机照片里发现了猫腻。
部分8GB版本M4 iPad Pro的主板上，竟然搭载了两颗标记为Z8DMS的美光内存封装。
网友顺着编号一查，发现对应的内存封装标称容量为48Gbit。
换算过来，每颗6GB，两颗加起来刚好12GB。
好家伙，苹果官方标称8GB，主板上的内存颗粒容量却足足有12GB？！
更有意思的是，高配版本也被扒了出来。
1TB版本使用的是另外两颗8GB内存封装，合计16GB，和官方标称完全一致。
合着高配16GB给得明明白白，低配却有4GB颗粒容量没体现在可用内存里？
这一发现很快引起科技媒体关注。
2024年5月20日，Tom’s Hardware专门发文，讨论8GB版本的M4 iPad Pro是否实际搭载了12GB内存。
苹果到底图什么？都已经装上12GB的内存颗粒了，干吗还要限制在8GB？
一种可能是供应链和成本。
M4芯片对内存带宽有一定要求，苹果可能发现使用现成的6GB封装，比采购或定制符合要求的4GB封装更划算。
另一种猜测，就有点耐人寻味了。
低配8GB，高配16GB，内存差距足足一倍。
而且想升级内存，还得顺带把存储容量升级到至少1TB。
要是低配给到12GB，高低配之间就只剩4GB的差距，部分用户自然也就没那么大动力买高配了。
这也是此次X博主最不满的地方：
苹果为了维持产品档位，宁可让现成的硬件容量闲置，也不愿意让用户多用一点。
不过，这里还有个关键细节。
目前拆机照片和颗粒编号能够支持的，是部分M4 iPad Pro使用的内存封装标称容量合计12GB。
至于额外的4GB能否正常启用、苹果是否主动进行了软件限制，以及背后究竟有什么商业考量，尚无确凿证据。
但有一点很明确：
当年这些M4 iPad Pro用户，最终能用到的就是8GB内存。
而这少掉的4GB，到了两年后，偏偏又撞上了苹果最新的AI功能门槛。
苹果这刀法，还有两年延迟伤害？
今年6月，苹果在WWDC上正式发布iPadOS 27，同时带来了新一代Siri AI。
虽然Siri AI国行版一鸽再鸽，但海外部分新功能的硬件要求已经公布。
其中，更自然的Siri语音、更高精度的端侧听写等能力，对iPad提出了一条新门槛：
M4或更新芯片，外加至少12GB统一内存。
这下，低配M4 iPad Pro用户一看，傻了。
芯片是M4，达标。
内存只有8GB，没达标。
好家伙，芯片明明还够用，结果愣是被4GB内存卡在了门外。
更巧的是，当年根据拆机图片推算，这款机器的内存颗粒标称容量合计12GB，恰好比系统实际可用的容量多出4GB。
这下是真有点难绷了。
当然，这里还是得说清楚。
8GB版本依然支持大量Apple Intelligence功能，受影响的主要是前面提到的“更高级的”部分特定能力。
目前也没有证据表明，只要把疑似多出来的容量开放，这些AI功能就一定能正常运行。
但对花大价钱买Pro的老用户来说，这条限制依然相当扎心。
谁能想到，当年只存在于拆机图片里的几GB内存，两年后竟然关系到了新功能的入场资格。
更气人的还在后面。
现在连定位更低的iPad Air，都已经全系标配12GB了。
今年3月，苹果发布搭载M4芯片的新款iPad Air，统一内存从8GB提高到12GB，增幅达到50%。
11英寸版本的起售价仍为599美元。
苹果甚至在发布稿里专门强调，12GB统一内存和120GB/s内存带宽，有助于设备更快运行AI模型。
与此同时，2025款M5 iPad Pro也已经将256GB和512GB版本的统一内存提高到12GB。
这么一对比，老用户更难绷了。
两年前售价更贵、定位更高的M4 iPad Pro，如今在部分AI功能支持上，竟然输给了更新、更便宜的M4 iPad Air。
关键M4 iPad Pro和M4 iPad Air用的还是同一代芯片。
老Pro的屏幕、接口等配置依然更强，但到了这次AI功能限制面前，“Pro”的名头还真帮不上忙。
过去大家吐槽苹果内存给得抠门，影响的无非是多开几个App、运行大型软件或者后台保活。
AI时代一来，玩法彻底变了。
内存不再只影响设备跑得快不快，还开始决定用户有没有资格体验最新的端侧AI能力。
偏偏iPad的统一内存又不能自行升级，买的时候是8GB，往后基本就只能一直是8GB。
至于未来还能不能跨过苹果的新功能门槛，就只能看苹果下一次把线画在哪里。
就，还是苹果会玩啊。。。
One More Thing
以前在历史课本里看到，经济大萧条时期，资本家宁愿把牛奶倒进河里，也不愿意降价出售。
当时只觉得荒谬。
（是那种明知道它为什么发生，依然觉得荒谬的荒谬）
如今再看苹果这套操作，多少有点熟悉的味道。
正如博主吐槽的那样：
想当年，我们还吐槽苹果把8GB内存卖得跟黄金一样贵。
现在才知道，原来黄金早就装进你的设备里了——苹果只是给它上了把锁，然后把钥匙扔进了太平洋。
只能说，时代变了。
但资本，永远都是那个资本。

title: 世界模型首次指导设计芯片！超大核NPU700TOPS，99%算力可用
content:
世界模型首次指导设计芯片！超大核NPU700TOPS，99%算力可用
AI算力利用“九九成”
贾浩楠 发自 凹非寺量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI
越靠软件吃饭的公司，越重视硬件——
以智驾模型知名的Momenta，出现在了一家成立仅仅两年多的芯片公司首次公开亮相里。
首款芯片，Day 0适配。
姐妹公司终于合体，最强智驾模型公司，如虎添翼。
新芯航途XHEART，现在成了Momenta的硬通货伙伴。
有模有芯，Momenta的智驾模型表现乃至公司整体，都面临新的价值重估了。
AI算力利用“九九成”，什么样的芯片？谁做的？
芯片名字叫X7 Ultra，只看算力数值，在2026年底已经不能算“极致”了——700 TOPS。
但官方更加强调另外两种参数。
首先是量化模型输出与FP32基准模型的相似度超过99.99%。
它想表达的是：X7 Ultra的确有更高的推理效率，但没有放任量化误差无限扩大，而是要求量化后的模型输出尽可能贴近FP32模型。
因为大模型实在太能吃算力、内存和功耗了，把模型权重和计算精度压下来的主要途径，就是减少存储与计算开销。但压得太狠，输出也可能出现偏差。
能否把这笔账算好，直接关系到有限的功耗预算里究竟能跑多大的模型。
第二个指标，是NPU计算利用率达到98.7%，意味着芯片里的AI计算单元，在运行测试任务时，绝大部分时间都在执行有效的计算工作，闲置时间很少。
这通常也意味着芯片架构、数据传输和软件调度之间配合得比较好，计算单元不容易因为等数据、等指令而空转。
官方给出的参考数据是：对比行业旗舰产品，内存带宽消耗降低80%，能效提升100%。
这时候再回头看700TOPS算力数值，就能理解其不同之处：
这是行业第一次用“大模型算力”描述芯片性能。
过去谈TOPS，多用稠密算力或稀疏算力，这些概念可以说明芯片的理论计算能力，却很难单独回答一个更贴近实际体验的问题：把真正用于智能驾驶的模型放上去，究竟能跑多快、跑得有多稳？
例如，实验室里的APS等测试指标单独测量某个模型的运行耗时，都能帮助工程师分析芯片性能。
但真实智驾大模型涉及复杂的网络结构、不同类型的算子、频繁的数据读写，以及多种计算任务之间的调度；只追求某个环节跑得很快意义有限，因为其他环节却因为等待数据、内存带宽不足或调度效率不高而拖慢整体速度。
最终，实验室基准测试与量产模型的实际性能、驾驶体验之间，就可能出现距离。
“大模型算力”的评测思路，是直接使用真实量产智驾模型测试芯片，而不是只依赖实验室基准测试。
这样一来，评测对象就从相对独立的计算任务，转向了实际部署中的智驾大模型。
这套评测还有另外几项明确约束：模型结构不能随意改变，计算精度必须得到保证，最终驾驶体验也不能打折，芯片需要在这些条件都成立的情况下，尽可能提高模型运行效率。
这就是“大模型算力”想要衡量的东西：在真实量产模型和严格部署约束下，芯片究竟能提供多少的计算能力，让性能数字更准确描述智驾系统实际要完成的工作。
而这个模型，在现在这个阶段，就是Momenta的R7世界模型——
也不瞒各位，这家芯片公司，的确和Momenta有极深的渊源。
新芯航途——XHEART，两家公司没有直接的股权隶属关系，只是Momenta创始团队成员曹旭东、夏炎通过控股股东间接持有新芯航途股份。
和Momenta属于“姐妹公司”，第一款量产产品X7其实已经在上汽大众的新车上量产，但这次的X7 Ultra发布是新芯航途第一次正式对外亮相。
大模型+大算力芯片，会带来什么智驾改变？
先想象一下智驾模型在车里工作的过程。
摄像头和激光雷达把数据送进来，模型开始一层层计算，最后形成感知与驾驶决策所需的信息，整套流程必须在有限时间里跑完。
问题是，芯片内部很容易出现一种尴尬局面：计算单元明明很强，却在等数据；某些算子算得飞快，另一些操作却拖住了整条链路；以及传感器数据越来越多，前端处理又排起了长队。
所以，端侧AI计算芯片最怕的，就是一处猛踩油门，其他环节还在慢慢悠悠地跟。
X7 Ultra的第一步，是把NPU做成超大核架构，并提升核间互连带宽。
这样的考虑直接由大模型计算方式驱动：
模型规模扩大后，大量计算任务需要组织起来执行，计算单元之间也会交换数据，超大核能配合更高效的互连，减少协作过程中的损耗，让计算资源更连贯地工作。
但矩阵计算快了，还不等于整个模型就快了，因为神经网络里还有不少“配角”算子，例如LayerNorm、Softmax和Transpose等等。
它们未必贡献最多的计算量，却可能反复出现在模型执行路径上，一个算子处理得慢，后续计算就得等着“接棒”。
X7 Ultra为这类操作配置了专用计算引擎，相当于把模型里的高频任务单独安排了工位，减少通用计算资源被这些操作占住的时间。
硬件的活儿安排好了，软件还得会派活。
模型在芯片上运行，需要经过编译和调度，但如果每个操作都独立执行，中间结果不断写回外部内存，再重新读出来，计算单元会白白浪费大量时间等数据。
X7 Ultra，或者说新芯航途为所有芯片构建了统一解决方案——AI工具链，通过计算图融合、并行执行和任务调度，把能够合并的计算尽可能连起来，减少中间数据来回搬运。
体现在这一款产品上，X7 Ultra的内存带宽消耗对比常见产品下降80%，能效提升100%——这两项数据对应的，正是减少数据搬运、提高计算资源利用效率的设计目标。
不过，智驾系统也不只有神经网络，传感器数据进模型之前，有不少前置的工作。
拿激光雷达来说，线数增加之后，同一场景会产生更密集的点云，细节更丰富，处理量也跟着涨；再比如，摄像头链路还有一个容易被忽略的问题：时延抖动。
X7 Ultra上针对性给出了方案，比如处理子系统中加入专用激光雷达加速器，每秒可处理2000万点，能够支持千线级激光雷达的点云处理需求。
针对摄像头处理链路，则优化了本地多核处理和流水线控制，处理稳定性相比传统方案提高100%。
当然，还有整颗芯片的“调度员”——CPU。
X7 Ultra采用Arm v9车规级CPU，这也是Arm v9架构第一次中国落地。
相比上一代，内核性能提升20%、能效提升10%，并优化了向量处理、多核协同和L3缓存访问。
最后一关是安全，X7 Ultra的SoC达到ASIL-B标准，集成MCU达到ASIL-D，承担不同层级的功能安全任务，为故障监测、控制和异常处理提供硬件基础。
把这几项设计连起来看，X7 Ultra并不是只盯着NPU往上堆算力，是把计算、数据搬运、传感器处理和系统调度一起安排好：
模型计算少等待，数据进出更顺畅，前端处理不拖后腿，整颗芯片才能更高效处理智能驾驶任务。
这也是新芯航途反复强调，相比实验室测试标准，“用量产智驾大模型测芯片”更合理的原因。
智驾摩尔定律，到底是什么？
早在自动驾驶还处于“刀耕火种”，也就是依赖高精地图+规则的年代、行业把“开城”作为黄金指标的年代，Momenta的CEO曹旭东就一直在行业里反复布道：数据飞轮、两条腿走路……
而他当年和大部队“格格不入”的认知，现在变成了公认的技术共识：端到端、无图、数据驱动、强化学习、世界模型……
这也能直接解释为何Momenta能在英雄辈出的自动驾驶江湖脱颖而出，合作车企广度、车型数量、方案搭载量上都一枝独秀。
XHEART第一次公开亮相，X7 Ultra发布开始，曹旭东首次对外更新了认知：
把“大模型定义芯片”称为Momenta的第三个重要判断。
核心定义是智驾模型的能力持续增长，计算架构也需要跟着模型一起演进，由此，智驾摩尔定律也需要重新评估。
这样的认知成型于2022年，并且在2023年由新芯航途开始实践，时间点对应的，是自动驾驶技术体系经历的快速深刻底层重构。
硬件层面，量产L2规模效应开始起作用，传感器、芯片成本快速下降，“超大杯”配置的智能方案，有了上车量产的基础。
模型层面，数据驱动的范式快速取代传统方法，不但是Transformer架构，模型本身迭代优化，也由人工调参和规则约束，变成了大规模、有特定分布特征的数据回灌，驱动强化学习。
而基于Transformer的端到端智驾模型，本质是通过海量数据学习环境表征、时序关系和驾驶决策。模型需要处理的内容越来越复杂，既要理解当前道路环境，也要结合连续时刻的信息判断车辆、行人和其他交通参与者的行为，最终形成驾驶动作。
世界模型则进一步强调对物理世界状态及其未来变化的预测，让系统具备更强的环境理解与未来推演能力。
曹旭东认为，自动驾驶的规模化落地，对应的端侧模型，可能需要达到至少10B、甚至100B参数级别，这样的才有可能让真正的L4落地部署规模百万级起步。
模型参数规模只是其中一个维度，算子类型、数据访问方式、计算任务的并行关系，也会影响模型能否在车端实时运行。
这就把芯片需要面对的计算需求摆到了更大的量级上——同时满足功耗、车规可靠性和成本约束，细化到哪些算子值得做专用加速，哪些数据需要减少重复搬运，哪些计算任务适合并行处理……都必须在芯片设计阶段与模型架构协同考虑。
如果能把数据飞轮、两条腿走路、原生架构的芯片三者结合起来，模型进步就不再只依赖算法团队单点优化，底层硬件也开始围绕模型的实际需求共同演进。
Momenta的技术体系就有机会贯通数据积累、模型训练与迭代、芯片计算，以及最终的量产部署。
2022年至2026年间，智驾体验大致每两年提升10倍，这是行业过去普遍认可的智驾“摩尔定律”。
但在“大模型定义芯片”的框架里看，Momenta已经实践出一条新的正反馈链路：模型决定计算需求，计算架构反过来影响模型能以多大规模、多少成本部署到车端。
量产规模扩大，又为模型积累数据、检验能力提供持续条件，各环节协同之后，单点技术突破就有机会转化为整个系统的迭代速度。
2年提升10倍，可能并不是一个规定死的数值。大模型定义芯片，正在加速智驾摩尔定律迈向每年提升10倍。
最有可能验证的，首先是L4自动驾驶落地应用，包括无人出租车、无人快递车、无人卡车等不同形态。
车端计算效率更高，而且具备芯片算子与IP级优化合作伙伴，且有成熟产供应链及成本控制能力的Momenta，成为一个影响权重最大的变量。
新芯航途的英文名XHEART，保留了一个可以继续延展的X：今天是汽车，未来也可能是机器人及其他智能体终端，Momenta的技术体系，有了从自动驾驶延伸至广义物理AI的可能性。
毕竟自动驾驶与机器人在感知、决策、实时响应和能效方面有共同需求，机器人更严苛的散热约束也让新芯航途一直重视的低功耗设计，具备更大的潜在价值。
当然不同智能体终端仍需要围绕具体任务重新设计产品方案，但面向Transformer大模型的芯片架构、底层工具链和软硬件协同经验，Momenta、XHEART已经先行一步了。

title: 刚刚，Claude宣布取消5小时限制！首批Ultra用户已「解封」
content:
刚刚，Claude宣布取消5小时限制！首批Ultra用户已「解封」
200美元Ultra用户先用
梦瑶 发自 凹非寺量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI
Claude200美元的订阅用户，终于可以和烦人的5小时限制说再见了！！
就在刚刚，Anthropic突然宣布调整Claude订阅计划。
原来的Max 5x和Max 20x正式改名，分别变成Max和Ultra。
价格倒是没变，依旧是每月100美元和200美元。
但这回，200美元档位的Ultra用户，还迎来了一项实打实的变化——
取消5小时使用限制。
根据官方说明，符合验证条件的Ultra用户，从今天起——
就能在每周额度内连续使用Claude，终于不用再被5小时窗口卡脖子了。
当然，目前大部分现有Ultra订阅用户已开始获得这项调整，新账号则需要等待验证，可以等等～
有一点需要敲重点哈：每周使用额度保持不变，仍为Pro用户的10倍。
大家觉得这诚意够不？
反正评论区…显然已经有昨天刚给自家Plus用户额度翻倍的人不买账了：
就这？建议学学28天重置计划。（笑）
还有网友锐评，直接把这波操作翻译成了大白话——
俺们Fable 5.5的额度消耗实在太惊人。
所以，唯一的解决办法，就是掏200美元买Ultra捏。（有道理啊）
Claude取消5小时限制，200美元Ultra用户先用
具体来看，这次Anthropic主要调整了两个高价订阅档位。
原有订阅用户无需手动切换，系统会自动将对应计划迁移至新名称。
对于Max 5x用户来说，这次主要是名称简化，价格和原有使用规则没有发生明显变化。
真正的重点，落在了原Max 20x的新Ultra用户上，按照官方刚刚发布的最新说明，Ultra订阅用户可以获得——
- 取消5小时限制： 已验证账户不用等待5小时窗口重置了，可以在周额度内持续工作。
- 每周10倍额度： 相较Pro订阅，获得10倍的每周使用量。
- 优先体验新功能： 包括新模型、功能和产品的优先访问资格。
- 支持Claude Code： 可以在终端中执行代码开发任务。
- 支持长程任务： 让Claude在后台持续处理报告、电子表格、演示文稿等复杂工作。
用最直白最不绕弯子的话讲，这次Ultra取消5小时限制之后，最大的好处就是——
已经完成验证的用户就可以按照自己的节奏使用每周额度了。
当然，这回福利对咱用户来说也有个《小门槛》。
A社也说了，大多数现有Ultra用户已经开始陆续解除限制，新用户则需要先通过账号验证。
验证会根据账号、支付历史等信息自动完成，咱们也不用额外折腾，等官方邮件通知就行。
至于怎么知道自己有没有成功「解封」嘛——
打开Claude的 Settings → Usage，如果发现那个熟悉的5小时使用进度条消失了，那就恭喜，解封成功。
为什么20x改名Ultra，背后还有一笔额度旧账？？
估计很友友心里跟我想的一样。
原本叫Max 20x的订阅，如今直接改名Ultra，所以名字里的20x，怎么突然消失了！！！
对此，Anthropic负责Claude订阅产品的Mike Overell，专门发帖解释了一番。
我们都知道最初Max 20x中的「20倍」，指的是单个5小时窗口内，使用额度为Pro用户的20倍。
后来Anthropic又增加了每周额度限制，问题就来了——
5小时额度是20倍，每周额度却只有Pro的10倍。
不少用户花了200美元，原以为能享受20倍额度，结果用着用着才发现，周额度还有另一套算法。
Mike Overell也承认，这种命名方式容易引起误解，并为此前的沟通问题道歉。
所以这次改名Ultra，也算是把一笔长期没说清楚的「额度旧账」，重新摆到了台面上。
而且，Claude的额度争议也早有先例。
今年6月《华尔街日报》就报道过，一名消费者针对Anthropic的高价订阅限制提起诉讼，指控相关产品的额度宣传具有误导性。
争议焦点之一，正是Max 5x和Max 20x订阅所对应的实际使用量。
从这个角度来看，这次变化也算是对长期用户反馈的一次回应咧～
但问题是，虽然规则透明了，额度也确实变了，但你这消息的时间点，多少还有点尴尬。
因为要知道就在昨天，隔壁OpenAI的Tibo义父才刚给Pro用户额度翻倍了啊。。。
Claude这波「改名」加「解限额」的操作，大家买账不？

title: When Electric Cars Were the Clean, Quiet Choice for Women
content:
At the turn of the last century, the automobile industry was still new and evolving rapidly. In 1898, there were about 50 carmakers in the United States. A decade later, that number had increased fivefold. In 1901, the companies produced 7,000 vehicles. By 1910, production had reached 181,000.
For several decades, electric cars vied with those powered by steam and internal combustion, and nobody was sure which technology would come out on top. Steam had the legacy of locomotive technology behind it but came with a risk of fire. Steam-powered vehicles could also become exceedingly hot, depending on the placement of the boiler and the steam piping. Both gasoline and electric cars faced logistical challenges: How far could you travel without refueling or charging? You could always throw an extra can of gasoline in the back of the car, but charging a battery involved more planning. The infrastructure for long-distance travel was not yet in place.
Before the invention of the electric starter in 1911, gasoline-powered engines had to be started with a hand crank; once running, they were loud and emitted noxious fumes. Fully electric vehicles, by contrast, were easy to start; you just turned on the main battery switch, often with a key, and there was no foul exhaust to deal with.
Electric carmakers looking for a way to differentiate their products decided that these attributes made their vehicles perfect for women. (Electric cars were also marketed to doctors so that they could make house calls in the middle of the night without waking the neighbors.) General Electric, which made car chargers based on mercury-arc rectifiers, was so captivated by the idea of women driving electric cars that the company created a series of advertisements featuring stylishly dressed women plugging in their cars and posing with their charging stations.
In ads for its electric car chargers, General Electric featured women using the equipment.miSci—Museum of Innovation and Science
A young woman named Fannie Goodnow was an early EV adopter. She owned a 1908 Bailey Victoria Phaeton, an open two-seater that really did look like a horseless carriage, and she used a GE mercury-arc rectifier to charge it.
Who Invented the Mercury-Arc Rectifier?
Electrical engineer Peter Cooper Hewitt invented the mercury vapor lamp, which became the basis for the mercury-arc rectifier used in car-charging systems. Bettmann/Getty Images
Electrical engineer Peter Cooper Hewitt is generally credited with the invention of the mercury-arc rectifier. During the first decade of the 20th century, Hewitt received several U.S. patents for electric lamps and other apparatus for transmitting and using electric currents. U.S. patents 968,896 and 1,163,706, granted to Percy H. Thomas, advanced Hewitt’s designs. Thomas was chief electrician for the Cooper Hewitt Electric Co., which Hewitt had cofounded with George Westinghouse to manufacture and sell his lamps.
The mercury-arc rectifier functioned as a diode. In a car charger like the one Fannie Goodnow used, it converted alternating current from the power grid into direct current needed to charge the car’s battery. A small amount of liquid mercury contained in a glass tube would vaporize and glow as electricity passed through it. Coupled with the carbon anodes, the vapor allowed current to flow in only one direction. This unit took about 12 hours to charge a drained battery.
A Carriage Maker Pivots to Electric Cars
I couldn’t find any records as to why Fannie Goodnow opted for an electric car. But as a well-to-do woman living in the Boston area, she had more than a half dozen automobile producers to choose from. The one she chose was S.R. Bailey & Co. of Amesbury, Mass.
This early electric car charger used a mercury-arc rectifier to convert AC to DC.Heritage Museums & Gardens
According to Galen Handy, who maintains the Early Electric Vehicles website, Samuel Robinson Bailey started in the carriage and sleigh business as a teenager, winning a best-in-show prize at a carriage exhibition in Portland, Maine, in 1855. Bailey developed a reputation as an inventor and designed processes to streamline the manufacture of his vehicles. He went into business for himself in 1882. Just over a decade later, one of Bailey’s carriages won a gold medal at the 1893 World’s Columbian Exposition in Chicago.
Bailey’s son Edwin attended the exposition, where he likely would have seen a vision of the future: the Morrison electric wagon. This six-passenger, battery-powered vehicle ferried visitors and VIPs around the fairgrounds. It wasn’t long before automobiles began eating into the carriage business. In December 1906, with the carriage industry collapsing, S.R. Bailey & Co. announced it was getting into electric vehicles.
Thomas Edison Designed a Bad Battery
Bailey’s first model, the Victoria Phaeton, used an Edison alkaline battery. Thomas Edison had been working on a lighter, more reliable, and more powerful battery for the auto industry since the 1890s, and announced the achievement with great fanfare in 1903. Unfortunately for Bailey and other carmakers who deployed it, the battery leaked and wouldn’t hold a charge. Edison was forced to go back to the drawing board. By 1910, he had a better battery in production, but by then his friend Henry Ford had introduced the Model T, setting the stage for the internal combustion engine to take over the market.
While Edison toiled to improve his tech, Bailey pivoted to a battery from the Gould Storage Battery Co. of Depew, N.Y. Gould also supplied batteries for railroads, utilities, subways, elevators, and farms. Goodnow’s Victoria Phaeton used a 30-cell lead-acid battery housed in a wooden box that was suspended under the chassis. The standard battery had a range of 64 to 80 kilometers; a larger battery with 50 percent more capacity was available for an upcharge. With the standard battery, the Victoria Phaeton cost US $2,000 (about $73,000 today, or about the list price of an upscale EV like the Audi Q8 or BMW i5).
Fannie Goodnow’s electric car charger now resides at the Heritage Museums & Gardens in Sandwich, Mass. But her 1908 Bailey Victoria Phaeton has been lost to history. Shown here is a 1911 version of that model.Sarah Thornington/Heritage Museums & Gardens
Goodnow installed a mercury-arc rectifier charging station in the barn adjacent to her parents’ summer home in Hull, Mass. Bill Lillie of Vintage Electric Cars notes that the charging plug was of an unusual design. This is, of course, one of the banes of any early adopter: nonstandardized plugs and cables. The Electric Vehicle Association of America, which formed in 1910, tried to put forward a standard so that electric vehicles could be charged at any charging station. (Modern EV owners can no doubt relate.) But savvy electric car owners knew to carry spare plug adapters and cables when traveling.
When Edison’s improved battery was finally available, Bailey began using it in the Victoria Phaeton and then went on a publicity blitz. In September 1910, the carmaker sponsored a round-trip tour from New York to Boston, with a side trip up New Hampshire’s Mount Washington, totaling about 1,600 km. Sadly, the “This Car Climbed Mt. Washington” bumper sticker hadn’t yet become popular.
Thomas Edison supplied the batteries for an electric car made by S.R. Bailey & Co., which then went on a publicity road trip from New York to Boston. miSci—Museum of Innovation and Science
Although Thomas Edison posed for a photo with the new Bailey Victoria Phaeton that featured his new battery, he himself chose a Detroit Electric Victoria for his own use. (Edison was known to be a terrible driver, so someone else likely chauffeured him around.)
Unable to compete against the rising tide of Model Ts, S.R. Bailey sold its factory in 1915, having produced about 500 to 600 electric vehicles.
Although the vehicle Fannie Goodnow chose turned out to be just a blip in automotive history, I like to imagine her driving about town in a beautiful car that embodied all the quirks of early adoption. I hope her friends didn’t make fun of her for investing in electric just before internal combustion took off. I hope she didn’t get stranded without the proper charging cable. I do not know what happened to her or her Victoria Phaeton, but her charging station remained in situ until 2022, when it was donated to the Heritage Museums & Gardens in Sandwich, Mass. Now it stands ready to tell stories of technological change and adoption that continue to resonate today.
Part of a continuing series looking at historical artifacts that embrace the boundless potential of technology.
An abridged version of this article appears in the November 2026 print issue.
References
For a detailed history of the development of the mercury-arc rectifier (or valve), see Deepak Tiku’s article in the March/April 2014 issue of IEEE Power & Energy Magazine.
Harry Cooke Cushing Jr., a fellow of the American Institute of Electrical Engineers, wrote (and updated regularly over a number of years) The Electric Vehicle Hand-Book, which gave general instructions for the care and storage of batteries, including how to charge them with a mercury-arc rectifier. Discussion of the mercury-arc rectifier begins on page 156 of the 10th edition, published in 1922. (The American Institute of Electrical Engineers is one of the predecessor organizations of the IEEE.)

- This Power Grid Pioneer’s EV Prediction Came 100 Years Too Soon ›
Allison Marsh is a professor in Women and Gender Studies at the University of South Carolina and codirector of the university’s Ann Johnson Institute for Science, Technology & Society. She combines her interests in engineering, history, and museum objects to write the Past Forward column, which tells the story of technology through historical artifacts. Marsh is currently working on a book on the history of women in electrical engineering.

title: Webasto poised to sell its battery systems business - electrive.com
content:
According to media reports, Webasto is seeking to divest its battery systems division. CEO Jörg Buchheim stated that the company is in advanced negotiations with two strategic investors. A deal could be finalised later this year. The proceeds would provide financial relief to the struggling supplier.
Production lines at Webasto's Korea plant.
Image: Webasto
This is according to consistent reports from
Handelsblatt
Automobilwoche
, citing statements by high-ranking company representatives on the sidelines of Webasto’s 125th anniversary celebration. The Stockdorf-based group intends to use the impending sale of its battery division to stabilise its financial position. Webasto had originally explored all options, including cooperation or a partial sale, it is said. However, the two interested parties with whom Webasto is currently in advanced negotiations are “both interested in a complete takeover,” Buchheim is quoted as saying.
As a reminder: nearly ten years ago, Webasto invested significant capital in
future markets for battery systems and charging solutions
. The supplier
launched production of battery packs in Germany in 2019
– specifically at a plant in Schierling. Following this model, Webasto opened another battery assembly facility in Dangjin, South Korea, about three years later, and
expanded it further in 2024
. This was driven by ongoing orders from Hyundai-Kia for the supply of battery systems for several high-volume all-electric passenger car models. To this day, the Hyundai-Kia Group remains Webasto’s anchor customer in the battery business. In 2025, this division generated approx. €300 million in revenue.
In this context, Buchheim emphasises that while the battery business is attractive, it also requires significant investment. According to the company, the division grows by an average of 25 per cent annually, and current demand exceeds available capacities.
Automobilwoche
adds: “However, Webasto itself lacks the funds to finance this growth alone. New production capacities can […] require investments of up to €100 million.”
The sale now explicitly concerns the global high-voltage battery business.
Automobilwoche
quotes Buchheim as stating that both interested parties bring not only sufficient equity but also industrialisation expertise and access to additional applications beyond the automotive sector. The division is currently operating at a loss, but the business plan forecasts a turnaround in 2027. While the supplier would lose a lucrative growth field through a potential sale, it could avoid future financing requirements for the division and use the proceeds to pay down pressing debts. However, no information has been disclosed regarding the potential purchase price.
Speaking to
Automobilwoche
, Buchheim said: “We do not need to make distress sales.” The restructuring is fully funded even without divestments; transactions would be an additional positive effect. Available liquidity exceeds the assumptions of the restructuring expert report from October 2025. The need for Webasto to restructure at all stems from its expansion drive after the turn of the millennium, when the supplier invested in several new fields. Webasto’s core business remains automotive roof systems.
Webasto was unable to recoup its earlier investments through steep revenue growth as planned. As a result, debts of approx. €1.5 billion euros have accumulated, pushing the automotive supplier into such a precarious position that an agreement with banks became necessary last year. Under considerable pressure, Webasto negotiated an extension of existing loans and additional borrowing.
Handelsblatt
summarises: “The owner families Baier and Mey had to temporarily relinquish control over the majority of shares. 2,000 jobs were cut.” Currently, according to Chief Restructuring Officer Johann Stohner, no further job cuts are planned. However, the downsizing course will continue in the long term. The goal is to reduce debt below one billion euros through various measures, Stohner is quoted as saying.
Among these ‘further measures’,
Automobilwoche
reports, is the search for new perspectives for the electric high-voltage heating business. Webasto is seeking new owners or partners for individual activities in this area. The division is said to generate around €50 million euros in revenue. “Here, too, a strategic partner is being sought who can integrate the technology into a larger system and scale it up,” the automotive trade journal writes. The background is the price pressure in electric vehicles. “Webasto has invested heavily in high-performance heating technology but sees a trend towards more cost-effective solutions. Further innovations would first need to be industrialised – and would again tie up capital.”

title: Walmart Hails Sustainable Supply Chain Progression
content:
Walmart Hails Sustainable Supply Chain Progression
Prioritise Us
on Google
Walmart's Sustainable Commodities Report covers the 10 years of its 20x25 initiative. Credit: Walmart
Walmart CSO Kathleen McLaughlin details how a decade of sustainable procurement and regenerative agriculture have reshaped global supply chain traceability
Enterprise supply chains are facing increasing pressure to eradicate deforestation, ensure ethical labour practices, and deploy advanced traceability across their supplier networks. Marking the conclusion of its ten-year 20x25 sourcing initiative, retail giant Walmart has released its 2026 Sustainable Commodities Report, detailing how corporate procurement can fundamentally reshape global commodity markets.
The initiative, launched in 2016, aimed to transition 20 key commodities - ranging from forests and grasslands to oceans - towards more sustainable production. Walmart is making use of these lessons to shift its supplier mandates from traditional certificate trading to rigorous traceability and jurisdictional governance.
“Healthy natural ecosystems and thriving producer communities form the backbone of retail supply chains, supporting the production of the food, apparel, and other products we deliver to customers and members,” says Kathleen McLaughlin, Chief Sustainability Officer at Walmart.
Kathleen McLaughlin, Chief Sustainability Officer at Walmart
Over the past decade, our work has focused on fostering more sustainable commodity production, helping conserve high-value landscapes and seascapes, and supporting the well-being of people involved in farming, fishing, ranching, forestry, manufacturing, and other activities across global value chains
Kathleen McLaughlin, Chief Sustainability Officer at Walmart
Kathleen McLaughlin discusses the blueprint Walmart is using to move beyond sustainability commitments and into the era of accelerated, large-scale results.
Deforestation-Free Supply Chain Verification
A major evolution in Walmart's procurement strategy is the introduction of a new deforestation- and conversion-free (DCF) verification policy. Replacing its earlier broader Forests Policy, the DCF mandate applies strict sourcing compliance to high-risk commodities such as palm oil, cocoa, coffee, timber, and South American beef. The mandate is complementary to other end-user
initiatives
to improve the sustainability of certain high-risk commodities, such as palm oil.
To maintain market access, suppliers must now undergo commercial audits that require spatial verification and third-party checks. Beyond land-use management, corporate sourcing rules increasingly demand direct human rights due diligence, tying commercial supply agreements directly to worker safety.
“While progress has varied by commodity and geography, the lessons from 20x25 continue to inform Walmart's broader approach to merchandising for people and planet and our ongoing efforts across these commodity value chains,” Kathleen adds.
Walmart has introduced a new deforestation- and conversion-free (DCF) verification policy to replace its earlier Forests Policy. Credit: Walmart
Scaling Regenerative Agriculture Partnerships
To secure upstream supply chain resilience, Walmart has aggressively scaled its investments in regenerative agriculture. Moving beyond basic soil and water stewardship, the retailer now collaborates with major packaged-goods suppliers to fund technical assistance for farmers. This localised training helps agricultural suppliers adopt vital practices such as cover cropping, nutrient management, and efficient irrigation.
Walmart has also established partnerships with PepsiCo and General Mills to provide resources to support technical assistance for farmers and help them adopt regenerative practices such as cover cropping, better soil and nutrient management, and water stewardship. PepsiCo has established several other
partnerships
to strengthen the sustainability of its sourcing.
Walmart also partnered with rice suppliers and growers in Arkansas to make irrigation more efficient and encourage more sustainable rice production.
Alongside these business efforts, Walmart Foundation investments supported adviser networks, farmer training, and local projects focused on soil health, regenerative practices, and water conservation in key agricultural regions and watersheds.
The report states that "building on this progress will require broader and deeper adoption of sustainable practices, continued improvements in traceability, verification and industry capacity, and stronger measurement of environmental and social outcomes".
The latest disclosure highlights measurable supplier performance and procurement benchmarks across the global network:
Land Stewardship Scale: Participating suppliers successfully managed 34.0 million grazing acres and 10.6 million acres of major US crops under sustainable practices.
Forestry and Fibre Standards: An impressive 95.6% of private brand pulp, paper, and timber products successfully met strict DCF verification standards.
Specialty Crop Execution: Private brand coffee achieved 99.9% sustainable procurement compliance under third-party verification frameworks.
Marine Compliance: 99.1% of US canned tuna met certified sustainable criteria or qualified for strategic Fishery Improvement Projects.
Labour Rights Monitoring: Direct suppliers accounting for 98.2% of fresh produce and floral net sales supported the Ethical Charter on Responsible Labour Practices.
Key Supply Chain Partners
: As a major multinational food and beverage corporation, PepsiCo acts as a strategic supply chain partner to Walmart. Through joint funding initiatives, PepsiCo provides vital technical assistance to agricultural suppliers, helping farmers optimize fertiliser use, improve soil health, and adopt regenerative agriculture practices across critical US row crop value chains to ensure long-term procurement stability.
General Mills
: Functioning as a leading manufacturer of branded consumer foods, General Mills collaborates with retail giants to improve agricultural resilience. By partnering with Walmart, General Mills supports local initiatives and farmer training networks, driving the adoption of cover cropping, nutrient management, and water conservation practices that secure sustainable commodity sourcing networks globally, reducing upstream supply chain risks.

title: Americold Opens Global Supply Chain Innovation Centre
content:
Americold Opens Global Supply Chain Innovation Centre
Prioritise Us
on Google
Americold opened a new Global Innovation Centre at its Atlanta headquarters in late October 2026. Credit: Americold
Americold CEO Rob Chambers launches a Global Innovation Centre to centralise automated facilities and optimise temperature-controlled supply chains
Global supply chain networks rely heavily on resilient,
temperature-controlled logistics
to safeguard food, pharmaceuticals, and sensitive commercial goods. To strengthen these critical networks, Americold Realty Trust has opened a state-of-the-art Global Innovation Centre in Atlanta, centralising the oversight of its automated logistics facilities worldwide.
Bringing together data and analytics, cybersecurity, and enterprise technology, the new facility is engineered to accelerate operational decision-making. At its core sits the Global Operations Command Centre, allowing the logistics leader to monitor and manage
automated
supply chain operations from a single hub. This eliminates the need to replicate specialised monitoring at individual regional sites - a massive benefit for globally dispersed supply chain networks that require high-reliability freight management.
Americold has responded to increasing demand for order-level fulfilment, packaging, and
last-mile delivery
Americold has been investing in technology solutions to support its ecommerce solutions. Credit: Americold.
Centralising Supply Chain Automation
Americold operates more than 220 facilities across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and South America, with an aggregate storage volume of approximately 1.4 billion refrigerated cubic feet. Americold’s 24/7 cold storage facilities rely on seamless operations, with staff using voice-guided wearable technology in sub-zero temperatures. Manual picking and scanning processes, combined with the challenge of wearing protective gloves, make voice-enabled technology a key driver of productivity and worker comfort.
The dense racking systems and high product volume pose a challenge to reliable wireless network design. Metal shelving and tightly packed items can interfere with connectivity. Americold has been investing to ensure that its network design addressed these current and future needs, delivering reliable and scalable wireless connectivity for enhanced operations.
Continuous Monitoring
: Delivers 24/7 visibility over global temperature-controlled freight, remote logistics hubs, and automated warehouse inventory
Rapid Incident Response
: Centralised problem-solving prevents minor warehouse bottlenecks from cascading into major global supply chain disruptions
Data and Analytics Integration
: Leverages digital transformation tools to optimise logistics routing, cargo execution, and facility performance
Supply Chain Resilience
: Creates built-in redundancy for automated logistics facilities, safeguarding essential consumer and industrial material flows
Capital Project ROI
: Aligns enterprise technology deployments directly with large-scale commercial operational needs to drive measurable business value
Dematic collaborated with Americold to design a WLAN infrastructure that ensured reliable coverage throughout cold store facilities in Australia and New Zealand. Credit: Dematic
New technology leadership
To lead this strategic technology rollout, Americold has promoted Anita Nanda to the role of Chief Technology and Solutions Officer. Anita was previously Senior Vice President, where she led the company's global development and automation efforts, managing the expansion of advanced cold storage infrastructure.
Before joining Americold in 2022, Anita worked as Vice President with responsibility for Project Management at Dematic. Nanda brings over two decades of experience in large-scale capital projects, automation, and intralogistics engineering. Her newly expanded role will connect enterprise technology strategy directly with operational priorities, ensuring that logistics infrastructure meets the rigorous, high-speed demands of modern supply chains.
Anita Nanda was appointed as Americold's Chief Technology and Solutions Officer in September 2026. Credit: Anita Nanda/LinkedIn
Key Logistics and Technology Partners
Americold:
As a premier global leader in temperature-controlled logistics and real estate, Americold provides essential value-added services and supply chain infrastructure. The company’s new Atlanta-based Global Innovation Centre unites automation, enterprise technology, and operational expertise to serve diverse consumer and industrial sectors, ensuring highly resilient freight transport and secure cold storage solutions for modern supply chains.
Siemens:
Operating as a global technology powerhouse, Siemens specializes in advanced industrial automation, digital infrastructure, and energy systems. As an essential ecosystem player in the logistics space, Siemens provides the foundational enterprise technology, software, and hardware solutions required to drive digital transformation, securing high-speed automated operations across complex, multi-node global supply chains and warehousing distribution networks.
Dematic:
Functioning as a leading supplier of intelligent intralogistics and materials handling solutions, Dematic designs and implements automated systems for global supply chains. Dematic's deep expertise in robotics and process automation directly supports the sophisticated, high-tech distribution centers and warehousing environments that logistics providers like Americold oversee via centralised, data-driven command centers to ensure seamless inventory flow.

title: PepsiCo: Regenerative Agriculture & Supply Chain Resilience
content:
PepsiCo: Regenerative Agriculture & Supply Chain Resilience
Prioritise Us
on Google
PepsiCo and the Earthworm Foundation are collaborating to drive more regenerative agriculture practises for supply chain resilience. Credit: PepsiCo
PepsiCo is scaling regenerative agriculture practises by partnering with Earthworm Foundation to ensure sustainable and resilient supply chain operations
PepsiCo has brought more than 250 farmers across France, Spain and Türkiye into
regenerative agriculture programmes
designed to strengthen supply chain resilience and secure long-term access to ingredients for its snack brands.
The collaboration with Earthworm Foundation addresses sourcing stability through programmes tailored to local growing conditions and farmer needs.
According to PepsiCo, the initiative supports ingredient security for brands including Lay's and Doritos while building resilience into upstream agricultural networks.
Value chain partnerships emerge
The programmes reflect a model built on multi-stakeholder engagement rather than top-down mandates. Suppliers, cooperatives, grain traders and farmers work within each regional programme to address practical barriers to adoption.
Archana Jagannathan, Chief Sustainability Officer at PepsiCo Europe, Middle East and Africa, says the approach recognises where supply chains begin. "Agriculture is at the core of our business, and farmers are at the center of our efforts to help build a more resilient and sustainable food system," she says.
"Their success is critical not only to the future of farming, but to the long-term security of the ingredients, communities and ecosystems that food production depends on.
She adds that the model requires coordination across geographies. "That's why we're committed to advancing regenerative agriculture in ways that work for farmers. Across France, Spain and Türkiye, we're partnering with farmers, suppliers, cooperatives and local experts to develop approaches that reflect local conditions and priorities.
"While each program is different, the goal is the same: to empower farmers with the knowledge, tools and support they need to strengthen resilience, improve productivity and help shape the future of agriculture."
In recent years, supply chain stability has been tested significantly. Unstable weather conditions have meant that crops are more vulnerable and yields are unpredictable. By investing in regenerative agriculture, companies like PepsiCo are investing in resilience across their supply chains, as it improves water retention, increases biodiversity and creates healthier ecosystems.
Regenerative agriculture can help farmers increase yields and reduce dependence on synthetic fertilisers, therefore
operating more sustainably
and protecting their own working conditions.
Archana Jagannathan, Chief Sustainability Officer for Europe, the Middle East and Africa at PepsiCo
France connects procurement networks
In France, the work operates through RE'COL'TE, a €1.5m (US$1.6m) initiative supporting 175 farmers in Hauts-de-France. The programme brings together PepsiCo, Nestlé, Tereos, cooperatives Agora and Unéal, grain trader Groupe Carré and ADEME France's ecological transition agency.
According to Earthworm Foundation, which leads the programme, the structure combines public funding with private capital to lower adoption barriers. The model could show how
procurement coordination reduces individual risk
across supply tiers.
RE'COL'TE builds on the Sols Vivants initiative, connecting PepsiCo with rapeseed growers already embedded in regenerative networks. That existing infrastructure allows the company to extend reach across crop rotations without building new procurement channels from zero.
Paul Pontfort, a farmer in the programme, describes the value in supply chain terms. "As farmers, we must constantly strike the right balance between long-term investments and the day-to-day economic realities.
"Programmes such as RE'COL'TE help us to reduce the risks associated with adopting new practices by providing financial and technical support. This gives us the confidence we need to take the leap and invest in the resilience of our farms for years to come."
PepsiCo aims for 2030
PepsiCo aims to see regenerative agriculture, restorative or protective practices across 10 million acres of land by 2030
The goal is to sustainably source 90% of key ingredients
Work towards deforestation- and conversion-free sourcing for high-risk commodities
Focus on building farmer, community, soil and climate resilience
Spain tailors supplier engagement
In Spain, the focus has centred on mapping obstacles within the supply base. PepsiCo assessed suppliers working in rapeseed, sunflower and corn, conducted field visits and interviewed farmers to understand financial and operational constraints.
According to the company, the insights shaped programme design around specific supplier needs rather than applying uniform requirements. The approach reflects a sourcing strategy responsive to regional differences in crop economics and infrastructure.
The programme remains shaped by direct input from farmers and suppliers rather than external consultants.
Türkiye scales implementation capacity
In Türkiye, attention is on expanding implementation capacity with sugar beet farmers. Field visits, soil assessments, technical training and ongoing support help growers adopt methods suited to local conditions.
The programme covers around 480 hectares and continues to expand as practices are tested. According to PepsiCo, the model tests how quickly new methods can be validated and scaled within a single crop supply chain.
The work reflects an approach where sourcing stability
depends on supplier capability
rather than contract terms alone.
Bastien Sachet, CEO of the Earthworm Foundation
Soil health links to sourcing risk
The partnership frames soil health as infrastructure that affects supply chain continuity. Bastien Sachet, CEO of Earthworm Foundation, says the connection between soil condition and sourcing risk has become clearer through the programmes.
"Over the years, we've come to see soil for what it truly is: one of nature's most valuable infrastructures. When soil is degraded, it doesn't only put agriculture at risk; it affects water, biodiversity, climate resilience and, ultimately, society as a whole."
He adds that regional variation requires localised sourcing strategies. "Across France, Spain and Turkey, we've learned that there is no one-size-fits-all solution. By building programs around local realities and farmers' needs, we can strengthen resilience and create lasting value for farming communities and the wider food system.
"But we cannot do it alone. Accelerating the transition to regenerative agriculture requires the entire ecosystem to move together, which is why it's so encouraging to see companies such as PepsiCo investing in and supporting this transformation."
European expansion planned
The partners plan to expand the initiative across Europe, bringing together farmers, suppliers and local
partners to scale regenerative agriculture
. According to PepsiCo, the work feeds into a target of adopting regenerative, restorative and protective practices across 10 million acres globally by 2030.
The company reported 4.7 million acres under such practices in 2025.

title: Lexus is taking a page from China for its next electric SUV launching in 2027
content:
Peter Johnson
| Nov 2 2026 - 7:16 am PT
Toyota’s luxury brand
is launching a new electric SUV in 2027, its first vehicle built in China in over two decades.
Lexus leans on China for next-gen EV in 2027
It’s official. Toyota is breaking from tradition, planning to develop and produce the new vehicle in China rather than its home market of Japan.
Lexus confirmed the new vehicle will be made at its new manufacturing plant in Jinshan, Shanghai, and will go on sale in 2027.
As the first Lexus factory built from scratch overseas, the company said the new plant will bring together its global manufacturing capabilities.
broke ground
on the facility in June 2025, saying the new facility will unlock “Lexus speed” as it aims to keep pace with domestic brands like BYD. Construction was expected to be completed this past August, with the first vehicle scheduled to roll off the assembly line in the fall of 2027.
The first Lexus model will be an electric SUV, produced using advanced manufacturing methods such as gigacasting to reduce costs and speed up output.
The facility will be a cornerstone of Toyota’s comeback plans in China, where it’s struggled to compete with local brands.
Production capacity will be around 1,000 units per month in 2027 as Toyota ramps up to “tens of thousands” in 2028.
Toyota’s sales
plunged nearly 20%
in China last month, marking its eighth consecutive month with lower sales than the year prior. The market in China “remained weak due in part to rising gasoline prices, while the market for gasoline vehicles and hybrid vehicles was particularly affected,” Toyota said.
Lexus TZ (left) and ES (right) Source: Lexus China
In the first nine months of 2026, Toyota sold just over 1.05 million vehicles in China, 18.9% fewer than in the same period last year.
Lexus’ new Shanghai facility is wholly owned by Toyota, enabling it to produce vehicles in China through its joint ventures.
The new electric SUV will go on sale in China in 2027. Specific details, including battery, range, and prices, have yet to be announced.
Lexus TZ (Source: Lexus China)
As part of its “with China, for China, strategy, Lexus said it will “continue to use China as a source of innovation,” adding it will “deepen localization efforts” to bring classic models to the market that meet local needs.
Toyota joins the growing list of major OEMs that are already tapping, or plan to tap, China for its next-generation electric vehicles.
Electrek’s Take
While in other global markets, Toyota is sticking to its “multi-pathway” strategy, which includes all powertrains from electric to ICE; in China, it’s being forced to adapt.
China is Toyota’s third-largest market, following the US and Japan. To stay competitive and turn things around in China, Toyota will rely more on local partners and suppliers.
Developing the new Lexus electric SUV in China first rather than Japan is significant given Toyota’s traditional ways.
Typically, it takes Toyota about four to five years to fully develop a new vehicle. In China, automakers are now building them in as little as two years.
Toyota, like many automakers at this point, is turning to China for new tech, batteries, production methods, and other EV components to keep pace.

His enthusiasm for electric vehicles, primarily Tesla, is a significant reason he pursued a career in investments. title: Electric trucks hit 50% of China's heavy truck sales, diesel demand falls
content:
Tesla Semi
electric trucks
Fred Lambert
| Nov 2 2026 - 6:44 am PT
Electric trucks made up 50.3% of all heavy trucks sold in China in September. That’s 33,100 electric big rigs in a single month, up 37% from a year ago, while the overall heavy-truck market shrank by 21%.
And it’s showing up in the oil data. China’s diesel demand is on track to fall by about 230,000 barrels per day this year, and trucks running on batteries and natural gas are doing most of the work.
In 2024, new-energy vehicles accounted for 13.6% of heavy trucks (12 tonnes and up) sold in China. In 2025, sales nearly tripled to 231,100 units, up 182%, for a 28.9% share.
Electric heavy trucks passed 50% of China’s sales in September 2026.
December 2025 hit 53.9%, but that was a rush. Buyers piled in before trade-in subsidies expired and new purchase tax costs kicked in, and the share dropped back to about 23% by March.
Then it came right back. Through the first nine months of 2026, China sold 226,400 electric heavy trucks, up 64%, for a 38.1% share. That’s already almost as many as in all of 2025, with a quarter still to go. In tractors, the big rigs that pull long-haul trailers, the September share hit 64.5%.
China sold almost as many electric heavy trucks in nine months of 2026 as in all of 2025.
That’s well ahead of Beijing’s own plan. This year, 11 government bodies set a target of 40% new-energy heavy-truck sales by 2030, along with 1.6 million of them on the road, 30,000 km of zero-carbon freight corridors and about 3,000 charging and swap stations. The market blew past that sales target four years early on a monthly basis, and CATL now says new-energy trucks will be half of China’s annual truck sales by 2028.
Why Chinese fleets are switching
It comes down to cost. In most uses, an electric heavy truck in China is now cheaper to own and run than a diesel one, and fleets run that math every day.
CATL claims savings of about 0.6 yuan per km. Independent numbers are more measured, but still favorable: a study by the ICCT and China’s CATARC found battery-electric trucks about 19% cheaper per tonne-km than diesel in good conditions, though they lose that edge at low annual mileage or when battery weight eats into payload.
Charging time is the other objection, and China’s answer is swapping. CATL’s Qiji brand operated about 300 heavy-truck swap stations at the end of 2025 and plans 900 by the end of this year and 2,000 in 2027. In August, it agreed to pay 2.56 billion yuan (about $370 million) for nearly 25% of Qiyuan Green Power, China’s largest heavy-truck swap operator with more than 1,600 charging and swap stations. Its new standardized packs hold 432 kWh and 513 kWh and swap in about five minutes.
CATL is already
taking the swapping model to Europe with Octopus Energy
The trucks themselves are domestic. XCMG led the segment in 2025 with a 15.4% share, ahead of SANY and FAW Jiefang, and the top three held 42.9% of the market. CATL supplied 60% of the batteries.
Electric is eating LNG, too
For years, the alternative to diesel trucks in China was liquefied natural gas. LNG trucks took nearly 30% of the market in 2024, when gas was much cheaper than diesel.
Now they’re losing to batteries. According to Kpler, LNG trucks had a 37% share of heavy-duty registrations in March, against 23% for electric. By July, electric was at 47% and LNG had collapsed to 11%. Monthly LNG truck registrations fell from more than 30,000 to about 6,200.
Electric trucks overtook LNG trucks in China’s heavy-duty registrations in 2026.
So China is skipping the “bridge fuel” phase for trucks almost as fast as it started it.
Diesel demand is falling
China’s diesel consumption already peaked. Rhodium Group found that diesel refinery runs topped out in April 2023, and apparent consumption dropped from 4.7 million barrels per day then to 4.0 million barrels per day in April 2025.
2026 is the steepest drop yet. Kpler estimates diesel demand fell about 420,000 barrels per day year-over-year in May, roughly 10%, and 460,000 in June. It expects a decline of about 230,000 barrels per day for the full year and only a 64,000 barrel-per-day rebound in 2027.
LNG and electric trucks displaced about 680,000 barrels per day of diesel in China in 2026, according to Kpler.
Kpler puts the gross diesel displacement from alternative trucks at about 680,000 barrels per day this year: roughly 450,000 from the LNG fleet built in recent years and 230,000 from electric trucks. Road freight still grew about 3% through July. China is moving more goods with less diesel.
There’s a catch. The fuel price spike this spring, tied to the Iran war, cut demand on its own and pushed more fleets toward electric. But that only explains part of it, and the fleet is still early: electric trucks will be only about 8% of China’s heavy trucks on the road by the end of 2026, according to Kpler. Every year of 40-50% sales shares compounds the diesel losses.
Meanwhile in Europe and the US
Europe is growing fast from a tiny base. ACEA data shows 5,120 heavy electric trucks (16 tonnes and up) registered in the EU through September, up 59.9%, for a 2.5% share. That’s up from 1.7% a year ago, but diesel still took 91.7% of all EU truck registrations.
A few countries stand out. Switzerland is at 24%, Norway 14.4%, the Netherlands 11.1% and Sweden 10.3%. Germany registered the most units at 1,722, but that’s only a 4.2% share.
The US doesn’t publish an official electric Class 8 sales figure, and that tells you something. The best indicator is the recent
order for 2,500 Tesla Semis through ZET SCALE
, which would roughly double the number of electric Class 8 trucks on US roads. Against about 230,000 Class 8 trucks sold per year, the electric share is well under 1%.
China’s electric share of heavy-truck sales is more than 15 times Europe’s.
Price is the big difference. The ICCT puts the median electric Class 8 tractor in the US at $411,200, against $172,500 for diesel. Federal tax credits for commercial EVs ended in 2025, and California shelved the rule that would have required fleets to buy zero-emission trucks.
Electrek’s Take
This is the biggest under-covered story in the EV industry right now.
Everyone argued for years about whether electric semis could work. Range, weight, charging, cost. China settled it the boring way. It got the price of a battery-electric heavy truck close enough to diesel, built swap stations along freight routes, and let fleet operators do what fleet operators always do: pick the cheapest truck per kilometer.
And the result is showing up where it matters, in oil demand. Trucks are where diesel lives. Displacing a quarter of a million barrels a day in one year, with electric trucks still only around 8% of the fleet, means we’re still early on this curve.
The contrast with the US is hard to watch. America has Tesla, a Semi factory in Nevada built for 50,000 trucks a year, and some of the best freight corridors in the world for electrification. But electric Class 8 trucks cost 2.4 times as much as diesel here, the federal incentives are gone, and the market is under 1%. The ZET SCALE order is real progress. But it came from shippers pooling their demand, and twe have yet to see these trucks get delivered.
Europe at least has the regulation, and its best markets, at 10% to 24%, are roughly where China was in 2024 and 2025.
The question now is how long Chinese truck makers stay home. SANY and BYD already sell electric trucks in Europe, and CATL is building the swap network for them. If those trucks can come close to China’s pricing, how long can Western truck makers keep charging 2x diesel?
Diesel trucks aren’t the only thing batteries are displacing. At home, pairing solar with an EV or a home battery can cut your energy bills dramatically.
